title: Banana Airways Demo
description: Feed your passengers. Or they'll eat each other. Run an airline with cannibal chickens, radioactive passengers and screaming babies you can throw off the plane. Fly, serve, repair and try to land. Play solo or with up to five friends.

title: DEVILS : THE BORUTA REVENGE Demo
description: DEVILS is an arcade-logic game with rpg elements created in the retro atmosphere of Commodore 64 computers. It was created using 16 colors known from C64.  The game is available in two language versions: English and Polish.

title: Dicepot Demo
description: You lost everything at the tavern. Now a witch offers a deal: your soul for a fortune. Roll dice that split, tick and chain-react, hire helpers, merge your dice and watch a single roll turn into a table of hundreds in this pixel-art idle game.

title: Victory's Grave: Death Before Dismount Demo
description: Top-down arcade tank shooter. Plant mines, hold your flag, and battle Soviet armor in a destructible Eastern European city.

title: Streak of Power Demo
description: Streak of Power is a turn-based strategy game featuring tactical duels. Aim your energy beam with precision, use gravity-affected satellites to change its direction, and take control of them. Outwit your opponent and destroy their base before they hit you.

title: WordMaxed Demo
description: Play five complete games of WordMaxed. Choose quick 5x5 or classic 10x10 boards, play solo, challenge the AI, pass and play, or battle friends online, with full scoring, tutorials, settings, and English, Spanish, and German support.

title: Project: YGG Demo
description: You will be embarking Yggdrasil, the last ship departed from Earth. You are the last mechanic for this long journey through the cosmos and try to find your coworker. Solve the mysteries and handle the last of humanity.

title: 771: Smile and work Demo
description: "771: Smile and Work Demo" is a first-person psychological horror game consisting of 7 unique gameplay segments, each created by a different developer.
developer: Admia, a1esska, 1ne2wozzz, POS, ranwoG, Nikitosik52, MrGD

title: Diggems Demo
description: Diggems is an incremental mining game about building a hoard you can actually see. Break gems, set off chain reactions, and forge stronger gear. Hatch pets to gather loot and keep your machines supplied, then defend it all from the creatures in the mine.

title: [The Archive] Demo
description: A turn-based roguelike deckbuilder where your deck is your health: every hit destroys cards. Descend through the Archive while it erases the floors behind you, gather cards worth keeping, and reach a Point of Return before your last card is gone.

title: Books & Blood Demo
description: Survive in a post-apocalyptic bookstore in this horror game. Fetch books for your customers to complete your daily quota. Explore the abandoned bookstore, and don't get caught by the horrors stalking the shelves.

title: Next Station is... Demo
description: You operate the final subway train of the night. Inspect each platform, watch the passengers, and decide whether to open the doors or leave the station behind. Make the wrong choice, and something may board with them.

title: AMERICAN LIFE SIMULATOR Demo
description: Start your own lawn care business, buy houses, rent out your properties, and live the American Dream in an open-world neighborhood life simulator.

title: Rats Survivors Demo
description: Survive endless hordes of rats in a fast-paced survivors-like game, upgrade your abilities, and fight to stay alive as the chaos intensifies.

title: Scale-A-Building Demo
description: A game about scaling a building

title: MEATRASH Demo
description: In this city, implant contracts outlive their owners. In an underground processing facility, dissolve the "waste" delivered each morning and recover the implants buried inside. A first-person work sim. Deliver them for pay, or borrow a few for yourself and others?

title: 墨渊牌 Demo
description: 盘古的大脑化作世界，世界深处那道缝里面到底有什么。以记忆为牌，摆阵、对撞、走进深渊——《墨渊牌》，武侠志怪卡牌 Roguelike。

title: Interlace Demo
description: Try Interlace for free. It is a collection of quiet logic puzzles on a woven grid: swap tiles until every row makes sense, as a word, a true equation or a chain of shapes, and every column matches its colors. No timer, gentle hints, and a first taste of the full game.

title: Blind Man's Buff Demo
description: An asymmetric online hide-and-seek party game. The hunter is completely blind — sound is the only light in his world. Hide, stay still, never make a noise. Play with friends over the internet or hunt bots alone. 2–20 players.

title: WHO CHANGED IT? Demo
description: Keep your eyes open and find the anomalies! "WHO CHANGED IT?" is a next-gen online anomaly game for 1-8 players. But there's a catch: the anomaly creator is one of you! Objects can move, disappear, or duplicate. Snap photos of anomalies in different game modes and beat your opponents!

title: Finesse Frenzy Demo
description: Finesse Frenzy is a fast-paced arcade game about eating smaller sea creatures while eluding rivals to climb the food chain. Quick consumption temporarily fills the finesse meter, scaling up speed and score. Do you have the finesse to maintain the increased speed, or will you crash and burn trying?

title: Don't Read It Demo
description: DON'T READ IT DEMO — is an indie horror walking simulator with a first‑person view. Only a book remains at the place where a person disappeared. Open it just once — and the familiar world disappears.

title: Bad Bunnies - Beyond Brackenridge Demo
description: Join Brenda the Bad Bunny as she hops around an exciting dreamscape collecting carrots and avoiding myriad dangers! Experience the thrill of being a bouncing bunny as she zooms about a quirky, curious environment leaping towards her next carrot to meet the quota.

title: Tinker Islands Demo
description: Gather your friends and sail a vast ocean filled with wonders and danger in this cozy Caribbean sandbox. Discover islands, gather resources, upgrade your gear, make a new home, and see what's waiting over the next horizon.

title: Gravity Circuit 2 Demo
description: Choose between the Gravity and Power Circuit in this action-packed 2D platformer inspired by console classics. The sequel to the critically acclaimed Gravity Circuit. Now available to try for free!

title: Flavio The Ghost Clown Demo
description: Battle challenging bosses in this Run & Gun action game. Generate resources in a tycoon-style workshop and upgrade your equipment in the shop to guide Flavio through these bizarre battles!

title: Late Shift Demo
description: Experience found-footage horror through the eyes of a missing cinema employee. Navigate a looping cinema, find anomalies, uncover the truth, and break the loop. Make sure every room is checked... thoroughly, or risk becoming another missing employee.

title: Infinigon Demo
description: Two triangles make a square. Cultivate a living field of neon polygons that fuse when they touch and split when they break. Socket facets into your own polygon lens, chain breaks into melodies, and climb from triangle to the circle. It keeps growing while you're away, too.

title: Shadowlight Demo
description: A turn-based stealth roguelike with classic ASCII graphics where light and shadow decide who lives. Slip through procedurally generated dungeons as a thief who strikes from the dark for triple damage, dodges torch-carrying guards, and loots a manor heist — or dies in the light..

title: Please Stay Seated Demo
description: 2-4 players run an amusement park by hand. Please Stay Seated is an online co-op physics comedy: carry your customers to the rides, strap them in, and crank the throttle for cash without flinging them into orbit. Hit the day's quota or start over. You're the crew, not the tycoon.

title: Click Bangbang Demo
description: Save the growing Wallflowers from waves of invading insects while helping them spread, grow, and flourish.

title: Spin To Breathe Demo
description: Pay for air to stay alive! Spin the reels to the sound of explosions while space pirates raid your casino. Build your slot machine piece by piece and hold out until rescue arrives!

title: Drowned Lake Demo
description: Turn on your camera and face the ██████ waters of the Drowned Lake. Play as one of three characters: fish, explore, gather resources, and follow clues to a missing documentarian. Survive found-footage horror inspired by Brazilian folklore.

title: Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered Demo
description: The ultimate Godzilla arena brawler is back, completely remastered. Choose your monster and battle it out with a range of brutal attacks through recreated cities and other locations. Face off against your friends and foes in local co-op or new online multiplayer.

title: Tiny Chills - Not From Ear Demo
description: Help out at your mom’s clinic, clean patients’ ears, and uncover the first signs of something deeply wrong in Velviano. A hands-on body horror experience where an ordinary town slowly becomes anything but.

title: No Way Back Demo
description: ”No Way Out” is a turn based strategy game with rogue-like and deck building elements. Player needs to defeat groups of enemies. Survive on a limited field by flexibly moving and building character’s build in the gaps between enemy attacks until you fall or defeat all enemies.

title: The First Pixel Demo
description: A single pixel wakes in the dark. Feed it, shape it, follow the patterns it leaves behind. Somewhere inside the noise are forgotten worlds, lost relics, and a question the pixel was never meant to ask.

title: Vet Van Organizer Demo
description: Organize your vet van 🚐 Drag cute animals in, rotate them and find a spot for everyone! Play the first 10 levels of the full game for free. 🐾

title: Dilbaz Demo
description: A tactical action-stealth game spanning the waking world, purgatory, and dreams. Sell intelligence, manipulate two warring empires, and turn the tide of conflict from the shadows

title: Choice of Life: Modern Ages Demo
description: Succeed in the modern world and know the value of your decisions. All or nothing!

title: Medieval Anomaly Demo
description: Medieval Anomaly is a psychological observation horror game. Memorize your surroundings, spot subtle deviations, and survive round after round. Test your perception in this playable demo across up to 30 unique anomalies!

title: Gulovacka Demo
description: Snowballs knock you back so hard that you will be flying. Your friends having a blast watching it happen. Put on a snowsuit of your choice and dive into chaotic snowball fight in Gulovacka.

title: The 9th Dragon Demo
description: Fight through the criminal underworld of 1980s Kowloon Walled City: The 9th Dragon is a brutal narrative-driven action game with tactical combat and branching choices, where every decision shapes the fate of the city.

title: King Alone - Demo
description: Tower Defence meets Action Strategy. Ride as the King at the head of a harvest wain. You protect everything you have left, and the Queen, blinded by your enemies.

title: Motel 51: Papers, Keys & Aliens Demo
description: Motel 51 is a motel management sim set near Area 51. Your uncle left you the place, and his debt to the bank. Work the night desk: check IDs and alien transit permits, decide who gets a key. Some guests leave a tip. Others leave a repair bill, and a few bring trouble to your door.

title: The Park Keeper Demo
description: Manage a national park where something is clearly trying to get out. Screen visitors, cover up incidents, and keep everyone convinced that everything is under control.

title: Inferno Cafe Demo
description: A compact rom-com visual novel with roguelite elements — let yourself be devoured and forge bonds with the monster maids!

title: DADCORE Demo
description: DADCORE is a physics based midlife crisis simulator for up to 4 players. Play as a dad on a classic dad weekend. Fix the house. Get groceries. Catch some fish. Five minutes, tops. Not counting the giant crab.

title: HANDS OVER Demo
description: Try HANDS OVER in this demo: a 5-player co-op horror game where harmless challenges become cruel tests of luck and nerve. Bluff, sabotage your friends and try to stay at the table until the end.

title: Football Story Demo
description: Football Story is a cozy football RPG and life sim about growing up, friendship, and a dream. Develop your skills, explore the town of Lumen Bay, help its residents, and build your own street football team. Rise from your first neighborhood matches to victory over the pros!

title: 荒山诡宿 Demo
description: Horror vlogger Song Qian checks into a remote mountain inn after getting lost at night. Film footage, explore the aged inn, chat with odd guests — then face inexplicable events after dark. Demo includes the full first chapter, ~15-20 minutes of gameplay.

title: Glooky: Cursors in the City Demo
Archi Vista Demo
description: Dig, wash, and uncover the lost artifacts in Archi Vista, a relaxing first-person excavation game. Break through layers of earth, clean forgotten ruins, find hidden treasures, and restore extraordinary places one satisfying discovery at a time.

title: Indie City Mixtape 2026 Demo
description: The Indie City Mixtape features seven small games, all contained within a 3D Platformer launcher. Ranging from shaving llamas to horror narrative, there's something for everyone in this ABSOLUTE BARGAIN of a collection!

title: Billiards Warrior Demo
description: 《Billiards Warrior》is a strategy action game that combines billiards physics, roguelite building, and fantasy monster battles. Aim, charge, and strike to launch the cue ball across the table in combos, defeat monster balls, collect relics and skills, and create your own adventure style.

title: Desktop Theme Park Demo
description: Desktop Theme Park is a cozy idle theme park builder that lives at the bottom of your screen. Place rides, connect paths, hire staff, and decorate your park. Keep it running to earn coins while you work or browse, then spend them on new attractions.

title: Super Ballsy Escape [DEMO]
description: Super Ballsy Escape: A fast, physics‑driven 2D marble racing platformer packed with tight controls and momentum‑based challenges. Roll, bounce, and boost your way to the fastest runs. Get ballsy and beat the clock.

title: Evidentia Demo
description: Evidentia is a cooperative detective card game for friends. Each deck is a unique case. Analyze evidence, take risks, question everything — and find out if you can solve it before the final reveal.

title: Dumpster Diving Simulator Demo
description: Arrive on a small island town flat broke and build a junk empire. Dig through dumpsters, flip your finds, win storage auctions, haggle at the flea market and grow from a trash bag to a loaded truck in this realistic scavenging life sim.

title: Rent A Car Together Demo
description: Start by renting your first car in Rent A Car Together (Demo). Expand your rental car fleet by purchasing different vehicles and grow your car rental business. Drive your cars and get them fixed when they break down. You can also develop your Rent A Car business by playing Co-Op.

title: WE'RE ALL IN! Demo
description: Experience minigame chaos in WE’RE ALL IN!, an online party game for 1-8 players where you win by betting on your friends in a series of fast-paced games and challenges.

title: Everyone Will Die Demo
description: Defend a medieval starving city and decide how far you will go to survive: slaughter horses and dogs, arm the old and the young, and sacrifice your humanity. A dark survival city builder where, sooner or later, everyone will die.

title: Fish World Demo
description: Eat or be eaten! Survive this endless oceanic survival action game! Start as a weak fish. Devour smaller prey to grow massive, and flee bigger predators! Evolve from a mackerel to a shark or legendary deep-sea fish. Feast to your limits and top the online "Global Ocean Rankings"!

title: The Pogo Witch Demo
description: A challenging hand-drawn 2D platform game. Master the pogo technique and climb to the top of the tower, where its creator awaits.

title: Rustmourne Demo
description: Demo for Rustmourne, a sci-fi survival horror game with detailed, VR-designed interactions. Traverse the corridors of an ancient, derelict structure and face the tortured beings within: hide, run, or cut off their limbs to survive. Will you understand the purpose of your awakening and get out alive?

title: wocheneinkauf Demo
description: Remember when grocery shopping used to be stress free? Me neither! Well we found a way to make it even more stressful. In wocheneinkauf, four different dimensions have recently collided. The world might be ending. Everything changed. Except one thing. You still have to go shopping.

title: PROF-MAN Demo
description: PROF-MAN is a frantic ’80s-style maze arcade game where speed, skill and survival are the keys to academic advancement! Race through four worlds of classic horror, outwit the relentless Twiddlers and climb the ranks of Horror University!

title: CARKNIGHT Demo
description: Destroy endless hordes of enemies behind the wheel of a heavily armed car in a fast-paced roguelike survival game. Experiment with powerful weapon builds, choose your driving style, and survive as long as you can in the arena.

title: Gate Guard Simulator Demo
description: Step into the boots of the castle guard. Inspect seals, expose smugglers and reveal witches. You decide who enters and who’s turned away. Will you uphold the law, or break it for your own gain?

title: Iron Hunters Demo
description: BUILD A WAR MACHINE. BREAK THE RUN. A survivor-like where you build a mech into an absurd war machine. Upgrade, evolve, and combine weapons mid-run to create game-breaking synergies as you battle hordes of enemies across alien worlds.

title: PERKS Demo
description: A chaotic 1-6 player physics brawler where you battle your friends with countless perk synergies. Draft and stack game-altering abilities to fire homing multishots, bounce plump bullets, or unleash twisters. Steal the best perks and turn the tide!

title: Deadly Dimensions: First Expedition
description: You wake up on the floor of a weird abandoned office building, nobody is there and the air feels heavy. You need to somehow find a way out. But without knowing, you find out that you are stuck in an unknown Dimension of Earth all alone... or are you really?

title: Data.exe - An Automation Game About Feeding An AI Demo
description: Data.exe Demo: An incremental automation game set inside a retro 1998 desktop. Feed the AI by hand, automate small parts of the process, upgrade your hardware, and eventually turn the entire system into a massive self-running machine.

title: Omega 3 Demo
description: Play the first chapter of a wild Atlantic salmon's life: hatch from the gravel of a mountain brook and grow your fry among the stones, the trout and the kingfisher. A nature documentary you swim through.

title: Orb Rush VR Demo
description: Try Orb Rush VR for free! Hit incoming orbs, dodge bombs, and chase new records in Rush, Combo, and the Side Switch challenge. An interactive tutorial helps you get started, while dedicated demo leaderboards keep the competition going.

title: Moomin: Midsummer Madness Demo
description: Midsummer is right around the corner in Moominvalley, when a sudden flood sets the Moomins adrift! Join Tove Jansson’s beloved Moominfamily and friends on an adventure of mirth and mischief aboard a mysterious floating theatre.

title: Mewtations: Dogma Demo
description: Build a cat colony on a cluttered board of cards. Craft, farm and gear up your crew, send them on roguelite expeditions with automatic battles, and stand up to Boss Huohuo's dog mafia, before the next tax note comes due.

title: Path of Damned Demo
description: A roguelike where combat is a slot machine you build yourself. Weapons, shields, and potions are reel symbols: every spin hits, heals, and grants armor. Pack your bag, spend souls on talents, and hunt the Source on a cursed island.

title: Delivery Today Demo
description: A package delivery game where you control an autonomous delivery drone. Manage your time well and use abilities to boost your chances, and remember; we promise Delivery Today!

title: EchoMon: Pack & Stack! Demo
description: Transform a chaotic store into a pristine collector's haven. EchoMon is a cozy first-person shop simulator where you organize an incredible 3,500+ elemental trading cards. Upgrade your skills, unleash magical sorting abilities, and experience the pure satisfaction of a perfect shelf.

title: IT BEGAN Demo
description: IT BEGAN is a single-player tactical horror shooter set in a sunken world of cults, monsters, and your own fears — where escape is no longer an option.

title: Shadow Mate Demo
description: Explore an abandoned research facility as Cynthia, a young girl who fights terrifying creatures using the powers of Belial, a parasitic lifeform within her. This free demo of Shadow Mate offers a taste of its world, exploration, combat, and dragon-like transformation.

title: Drone Horizon: Force & Effect Demo
description: Demo version of Drone Horizon: Force & Effect. The demo allows you to design and configure drones, and with your drone explore the game world that will be available in base game.

title: GreyWake: Project Somnium - Prelude
description: GreyWake: Project Somnium – Prelude is a first-person puzzle-horror experience focused on environmental puzzles, atmospheric horror, and story. Explore GreyWake, uncover clues, solve puzzles, and find a way forward.

title: ASTRIDER Demo
description: Arcade air combat set in an alt-history Cold War gone hot in 1967, in a world where the strangest conspiracy theories turned out real. Fly three twelve-mission campaigns, one per faction, against targets on land, at sea, and in the air, with fully-voiced visual-novel scenes between sorties.

title: Islandry Demo
description: Turn a wild island into a thriving, self-running production network. Gather resources, build farms and machines, automate with drones and conveyor belts, process goods, manage interconnected production, earn profits from trading, and ship your products across the sea in this cozy automation game.

title: Project Betrayal: Midnight Terror Demo
description: Project Betrayal is an online asymmetrical horror game. Four friends explore a procedurally generated manor but one of them is tasked with betraying the others. Will you fall victim to the Traitor or become one yourself?

title: AETHERIA Demo
description: A high-speed aerial roguelite demo with full 360° 3D combat. Fly freely, fight enemy swarms, and combine automatic attacks, skills, and randomized upgrades. Explore the purple realm as the cat-eared character in this single-player demo.

title: Codex Lost 2 Demo
description: Explore the opening areas where danger, magic and secrets await in an interconnected labyrinth on Codex Lost 2 DEMO.

title: Maid in Wonderland Demo
description: Your fate, your duty, your suffering / love.

title: PatchWorld Demo
description: Unleash your imagination in PatchWorld, where music, art and creativity come to life. Through logic, physics and intuitive building blocks, create, share and discover worlds upon worlds. Bring your ideas to life or remix the community’s, on your own or with friends.

title: Home Reset: Organizing Simulator Demo
description: Transform a messy home into a cozy, beautifully organized space. Clean, arrange, and decorate every room your way—there are no wrong choices. Relax, get creative, and experience the joy of a fresh home in this demo.

title: Sobakistan: The Land of Dogs Demo
description: Sobakistan — the land of dogs, is a darkly satirical narrative immersion in a closed-off totalitarian dog state — where any step could send you to prison. Rich story, choices with consequences, bureaucratic card battles, text-based soulslike.

title: Timopet Demo
description: Register your to-dos as quests and focus with a timer. Cute desktop pets keep you company right on your screen! Complete a quest and your pets will give you coins as a gift! Open boxes with the coins you collect and gather all kinds of pets.

title: Quiet Bloom Demo
description: Quiet Bloom is a cozy idle game. Awaken the wind, dig wells, and call the rain to tend your land for you. Gather wood, stone, and water, raise wind vanes and solar panels, and watch a cracked desert slowly bloom into a luxuriant green oasis.

title: Refuel Together Demo
description: Run a gas station in co-op with up to 4 players in Refuel Together (Demo). In this demo, refuel and clean cars arriving at the gas station. Serve snacks to your customers at your cafe. Add more pumps, more cars will come. Become popular as you meet your customers' demands.

title: Obscuroid Demo
description: Obscuroid is a psychological horror puzzle game where you use a changing non-Euclidean environment to solve puzzles. Venture through a mind-bending liminal realm, use Polaroids to manipulate your surroundings, conjure your escape, or be consumed by whatever might wander the realm's vacant halls.

title: Angel Investor Simulator™ Demo
description: Invest into promising startups with sometimes wacky ideas. Help them grow with your team of experts. Capture the market share with quality product, smart pricing and marketing. Cash out big after the IPO. Compete with the other angels and show them who's the boss.

title: Attack of J Demo
description: Inspired by its creator’s real experiences, Attack of J is a choice-driven narrative game. Explore the opening of Jiang Chang’s story, shape his personality through choices, tackle absurd minigames, and enjoy animated CGs. How will you respond to life?

title: TIP or RIP Demo
description: TIP or RIP is a fast-paced action roguelike where you serve hungry monsters before they lose patience and eat you. Dash between tables, throw food, build ridiculous serving abilities, survive three increasingly dangerous restaurants, and feed the final mega-boss.

title: DeepCorp Rescue Demo
description: Play the first 9 missions of DeepCorp Rescue. Master arcade rocket flight, rescue trapped personnel, manage fuel, avoid hazards, and land safely. Wishlist or buy the full game on Steam to continue the rescue operation.

title: My Snake Likes Apples Demo
description: A short, minimalist incremental game about raising a foolish snake and helping it go the distance.

title: Crimson Ark Demo
description: A dark fantasy action RPG with three playable heroines. Hunt for random loot, enhance your gear, and build your magic. Use optional auto-hunting in the field, then take manual control for boss fights. Explore the opening region in this level-20 demo.

title: Lilac Wave Demo
description: Choose your magical sea creature, synergize spells, and dominate battles where strategy is your only weapon. Channel mystical pools day by day, survive ocean perils, and craft the perfect build to face the final boss. The fate of the deep is in your hands!

title: Drums & Steel Demo
description: Command formations of 18th-century style armies in real-time strategic combat. Maneuver infantry, cavalry, and artillery through skirmishes and in this demo. May the best army win.

title: Karon: Overclock Demo
description: For 200 years, the world has revolved around lies. Charon, the last descendant of Polux, climbs to the ground occupied by the Machine Army to reclaim the stolen Core. Use the materials you gather by defeating enemies to rebuild the forgotten factory and face even stronger foes.

title: Goblin Smasher Demo
description: Hover over goblins and your hammer smashes them. In the free demo you liberate two goblin lands, forge your first hammers and break the Warg Mother in about half an hour. A crunchy pixel-art incremental.

title: Veriventure Demo
description: Create dungeons from a toolkit of 100+ pieces to create traps, puzzles and combat. Or, play through a built-in story, and explore online levels uploaded by others.

title: Yukinite Depths Demo
description: Dig. Mine. Upgrade. Repeat. Launch expeditions in this relaxing pixel-art strategy and incremental game, gather rare resources, earn prestige ...and fight the bosses lurking in the depths.

title: Sunstone of Time Demo
description: Step into the role of a brilliant scientist whose fascination with ancient relics leads to an unexpected journey through history. Sunstone of Time is a historical VR odyssey where exploration, secrets, and intricate puzzle-solving are your keys to survival in the vibrant world of the Aztecs.

title: xiuzhen-chronicles/Demo
description: A rule-driven cultivation life simulation RPG. Start as an ordinary mortal, cultivate, gather resources, build relationships, choose your path through sects or as a wandering cultivator, and respond to a changing world where time, NPCs, and opportunities continue to move with or without you.

title: Caïssa Board Demo
description: Caîssa Board is a graphical chess user interface that is evolving toward becoming an online chess club.

title: Smash Their Heads Demo
description: Smash mechanical heads in a twisted circus! A short active incremental game. Cash in poker chips, upgrade your launcher, and keep the crowd entertained before they get bored!

title: Time Champions Demo
description: Recruit units from different historical periods and defend the timeline against alien invaders in this action-roguelike. Mix and match units to discover game-breaking synergies and use hero powers to survive enemy hordes. Unlock new units and evolve them to wreak absolute chaos on the battlefield!

title: Incremental Bowling Demo
description: Incremental Bowling is exactly what it sounds like. Shove bowling pins into the score area, buy upgrades, and automate the whole lane to score more and more points!

title: Towers to Be Demo
description: Platform and zoom around a dream-like world to discover what happened to the mind of this patient.

title: Siege of Incrementalia Demo
description: Command an undead army and lay siege to a continent in this incremental strategy game. Build war machines, sacrifice minions and automate hellish magic in your quest to unite the lands of Incrementalia by force.

title: Jellscape Demo
description: Welcome to the Jellscape Demo! Manage your way through 6 levels (and the tutorial) through skill or sheer willpower. See how fast you can beat each level, or explore the desolate world to find hidden collectibles. There are skins to unlock, times to beat, but do you have it in you to take on the challenge? Find out right now!

title: Sakura no Uta -To Dance Over the Cherry Blossoms- Demo
Room Movers Demo
description: Grab one end, I'll take the other. A cozy game about unboxing and arranging tiny diorama rooms, with a friend or on your own. No grid, no score, no timer. Just you, your friend, and a room that slowly becomes a place.

title: SCP - Containment Breach Revival Demo
description: SCP - Containment Breach Revival is an In-Development remake of SCP - Containment Breach, aiming to be a mostly faithful recreation with additional creative liberties taken. Step into the shoes of D-9341 once again and see what's new, what's changed, and what's to come.

title: Soul General demo
description: The game is an ancient-style musou roguelike action game. Players will lead a powerful allied squad to charge into enemy lines and resist invasion. As players progress, more mysterious events and ultimate challenges will be unveiled.

title: Anomagram Demo
description: Anomagram Demo: a horror set on a night shift moderating a short-video feed. Some videos are not normal. The anomaly doesn't stay inside the video. It reaches the terminal, and you. Approve or report each post; decisions can't be undone. The demo covers the first three nights, in five languages.

title: Never Wither Demo
description: Experience unprecedented creature collection gameplay—Transform into almost any creature you see! Collect and raise fantastical creatures, and command them to farm, build, and craft. In this open world survival crafting game, Establish your settlement, become the last hope against the Corruption.

title: Killing Things With Your Friends Demo
description: Rip limbs off mutants and use them as weapons in this chaotic co-op survival game about dark humour and dismemberment. Hack through mutant hordes, work as a team, and survive lethal challenges for profit!

title: Anatomy of a Dream Demo
description: You wake up somewhere that shouldn't exist.The rooms feel familiar, yet every hallway leads somewhere impossible. Memories bleed into architecture, familiar places dissolve into dream logic, and every answer raises another question.As you venture deeper into the Dreamscape, you uncover the remnants of those who wandered before you.

title: Little Frontier Demo
description: A story-rich Western tactical RPG set in 1836. Lead three mountain men across the vast, untamed American frontier. Explore the wilderness, engage in tactical turn-based combat, and navigate dangerous encounters where your decisions shape the story and the fate of your companions.

title: Cardwork Demo
description: Cardwork is a Deck-Building Roguelike Adventure Game focused on crafting your very own unique set of cards. Choose when and how to CUT them and recombine them back together to build the best deck possible.

title: That Mountain Needs to Fall Demo
Fieldmade Demo
description: Everything in this world is something you drew. Sketch a hoe and till the soil with it. Sketch an axe, a watering can, a fishing rod... and they become real, working tools with real stats. You can draw literally anything you want.

title: Kintsugi Cottage Demo
description: A cozy 3D jigsaw restoration game. Hundreds of shards lie across a cottage museum floor, and every glaze, curve and pattern is a clue. Work out which pieces belong together, rebuild the artifacts by hand, and restore the full artifact collection.

title: DeadFront Demo
description: DeadFront Demo is a 1-to-6 player co-op wave-based zombie survival shooter. Fight off hordes, upgrade weapons at the bench, buy perks from the mystery box, and survive the apocalypse!

title: Ministry of Time Demo
description: Step into the Ministry of Time and take your first shifts as a temporal border officer. Inspect travelers, check documents, uncover anomalies, and protect the timeline. The demo includes 5 in-game days and lets you experience almost all of the core mechanics.

title: Monster Showdown Demo
description: Survive escalating waves of monsters in a fast-paced first-person horde shooter. Earn cash, build your arsenal, upgrade your weapons, grab powerful Perk Donuts, repair defenses, defeat bosses, and unlock wild modifiers that change the way you play.

title: Village Invaders Demo
description: A fast-paced roguelite card battler where you raid villages. Deploy your army, cast wild spells and build the perfect deck to crush every kingdom in your path.

title: Robust Island Demo
description: Farming Is Just Beginning Winter is only the beginning of your journey. As Robust Island progresses into Spring and beyond, farming becomes a much larger part of the experience with crops, seasonal activities, additional events, expanded cooking, and more ways to shape your life on the island.

title: RMRF Demo
description: Play through the first 20 levels of RMRF in this free demo! RMRF is a challenging retro Aero 3D twin-stick shooter with demanding movement, handcrafted stages and destructible bosses. Develop Nat’s blaster, rescue cats, and research equipment. This game will test you. Delete or be deleted in RMRF.

title: Dirty Derby Demo
description: Dirty Derby is a multiplayer party game for 2-4 players. Read the animals that line up differently each round, and shape the finish order your contract demands. Grab your gear and jump onto the track — knock down anyone in your way. Only results remain: outdo the rest and prove yourself.

title: Critter Rumble Demo
description: Build your team of monsters, choose which enemies to fight, recruit the ones you defeat, and evolve your team in a roguelite autobattler with permanent buffs. Adapt your strategy and face increasingly powerful Bosses!

title: Ethral Demo
description: Play as a young hero in a retro pixel top-down adventure: explore the land of Ethral, find secrets, conquer dark dungeons, and collect shards to restore the Ethral Pendant to defeat the Pirate King!

title: Desert Survivors Demo
description: Destroy the endless hordes of desert monsters and break the curse! Choose your character, combine your abilities, and create your own devastating build. Can you survive the unforgiving desert?

title: Lootlands: Idle ARPG Demo
description: What if Path of Exile played itself? Build your hero, automate the grind, and collect god-tier loot. Even while you sleep.

title: Bocage, a cozy puzzle game (Demo)
description: Bocage is a cozy isometric puzzle game where every farm piece has its own needs. Fill the grid tile by tile. Fence in the cow. Grow wheat around the windmill. Rethink each move as the constraints pile up. No timer, no game over.

title: Portal way Demo
description: Portal way is a spatial puzzle about finding a path through portals.

title: Bancet Demo
description: Survive alone or with friends in a chaotic frog survival adventure. Fish, loot, steal, throw, poop, and somehow earn enough coins before another ridiculous day begins.

title: Ashen of Thrones Demo
description: Try Ashen of Thrones for free. Play the first missions of each civilization's campaign, command your army in skirmishes with up to 4 factions and survive 10 waves of enemies in this 2D real-time strategy game. - Skirmish: battles with up to 4 factions. - Survival: hold out through 10 waves.

title: The Knight of Niraking: Dawn of a New Era
description: Prince Gadion has killed his father, and his sister, Princess Kathine, has fled for her life. Play as a young shepherd boy called out as the first Knight of Niraking ever called out by the Gallant Sword. Get the Gallant Sword and be the first hero to save the land of Niraking!

title: Ram Fights Demo
description: Step into the arena in the free demo of Ram Fights! Take control of a fierce mountain ram, master tactical headbutts, and team up with your friends in Co-op mode. Send your enemies flying with hilarious ragdoll physics in this wild animal brawler.

title: Midnight Souls Demo
description: Dive into the secrets of the quiet hamlet of Camomile Peaks! A romantic trip to meet your online crush spirals into a mystical adventure—epic battles, bizarre allies, and dark humor. Win her heart, solve the mysteries, and protect your cat, Charlie!

title: Covert Koalas: Phasco Demo
description: Embark on a comfy search for hidden koalas across hand-drawn levels that get gradually colored as you finish them. Follow their story of zoo escape in search of new home. Original music, drawn cutscenes, difficulty modes and over 300 koalas in the demo. Every playthrough is different!

title: Photoncytosis Demo
description: Try Photoncytosis, an idle desktop life simulation. A tiny organism feeds on your screen's light and grows while you work. Explore the first research tier, inspect its cells under the microscope, and complete five colony goals. Play without a time limit.

title: Joker's Last Call Demo
description: A dark casino roguelike based on One Card, a fast and aggressive Korean card game rarely seen outside Korea. Stack attacks, counter two rivals, build rule-bending relic combinations, and reverse a deadly chain with a single Joker.

title: My Bookshop Dreams Demo
description: Manage and customize your shop, help curious readers, stock shelves and participate in special events. Come and flip the pages with us in this limited access experience of My Bookshop Dreams.

title: It Was Not a Suicide Demo
description: A psychological horror detective simulation set in Rainier Falls in 2005. Uncover the truth behind Adele's death by finding contradictions in the case files. Are you brilliant enough to expose the suspects' lies in a single attempt? Because you only get one chance to make an arrest.

title: Pay Your Space Debt Demo
description: An incremental survivor-lite where you must earn your way out of debt by mining entire asteroid fields, upgrading your spaceship and surviving the debt collectors.

title: Kitaria Fables 2 Demo
description: Join new heroes Alice and Dusty as they take their first steps into the wilds of the Arkadera Peninsula in the Kitaria Fables 2 demo! Get to know the locals of Whitewall Town, help them with their requests, and explore the breezy coastal lowlands, either alone or with a friend!

title: Stinker Golf Demo
description: An online 1-16 player destructive golf game where you build the course while you play. Annoy your friends without ruining the hole for yourself, all inside a fully physics simulated pixel world.

title: Cat Customs Simulator Demo
description: Inspect adorable cats at the border! Check passports, verify luggage weight, scan suspicious suitcases, and uncover unallowed items. Spot mismatches, catch smugglers, and decide who gets through customs in this cozy cat inspection simulator.

title: Rami on Watalands Demo
description: Rami on Watalands is a cozy farming adventure where you grow crops and transform into them to explore a world of islands. Each crop grants a unique ability: slide through rabbit holes, walk on water, summon rain, and discover new places.

title: Epsilon Zero Demo
description: "Epsilon Zero" is a fast-paced top-down action roguelike shooter where every mission is an all-out assault. Use devastating weapon combinations, unlock powerful upgrades, adapt your tactics, and exterminate everything standing in your way.

title: Arena Of Realms Demo
description: Arena of Realms blends auto-battling, team building, and tournament management. Recruit fighters, train your roster, and combine equipment and relics to win a 16-team double-elimination tournament. Scout rivals, place wagers, and compete solo or in multiplayer.

title: MoonStreet Demo
description: EXPLORE A 2.5D CINEMATIC WORLD. As the doomed city of Astro deals with civil unrest, climate-catastrophes and power-outages, you play a scientist-robot duo who must solve the mysteries of this world. The classic Point & Click system has been reinvented for a new type of action-packed storytelling.

title: Salty Dogs Demo
description: Salty Dogs is a co-op 2D physics-based action game about a squad of badass dogs who arm up and dive into a corrupted ocean. Blast mutated sea life, haul loot back to your submarine, upgrade it between runs, and fight your way down through the dark toward dreadful Cat-o-Cthulhu.

title: Cat Over Here! Demo
description: A Cozy Hunt Through a Factory Full of Cats! Slow down, explore, and enjoy a cozy game of hide-and-seek. Can you spot every cat over here?

title: Space Suits Demo
description: Explore the galaxy. Unearth ancient technology. Recruit, train and command your crew – or maroon them on a nearby comet to save oxygen. Play as a lost spacefarer in this golden age sci-fi adventure - can you find your path home?

title: Hello Triangle: Build a GPU - Demo
WINNIE-THE-POOH: Honey Distortion Demo
description: 🧸 WINNIE-THE-POOH: Honey Distortion 🍯 is a mystery visual novel with point-and-click mechanics, inspired by A. A. Milne's stories.

title: 通魂纸 Tonghun Paper Demo
description: Tonghun Paper is a first-person horror exploration game. Search for clues, read old letters, and evade danger. This early prototype demo tests character controls, interactions, and game progression and does not represent the final game's quality.

title: Fold'Em Demo
description: Join the table for a surreal high stakes poker card game experience. Discover creepy characters and survive each round with whatever you can. There is something sinister at play...

title: Yandere Apocalypse Demo
description: A chaotic bullet-heaven roguelite. Play a yandere carving through hordes of rival girls while protecting Senpai, a catastrophically stupid boyfriend who keeps wandering off, getting charmed and getting kidnapped. Evolve your weapons. Get him back. Again.

title: Survival Of Runt Demo
description: An open-world PvPvE survival shooter where cooperation and betrayal coexist. Choose between Chaos and Order to claim victory, and if you fall, revive as a formidable Mutant Player to hunt down the remaining survivors.

title: Dumbfire Demo
description: Launch a missile and thread it through tight obstacles as fast as you can to take out the target. A physics time-attack flight game. Chase faster and more daring runs for more points. For fans of Superflight and Clustertruck.

title: SU-93 Survivor Demo
description: Survive room after room in a tactical survivor-like: rebuild your weapons every fight, keep your passive items, and create stronger synergies with every choice. This demo offer you to test the 1st chapter of the game.

title: Your quest, please - Demo
description: Play as an NPC deciding whether the hero standing in front of you should have its quest approved or rejected using books, spells, and your logic. Make too many mistakes and your boss will happily fire you. Are you up to the challenge?

title: Critter Vs. Predators Demo
description: The food chain is fighting back. Collect a squad of tiny garden critters, gear them up and send them against the foxes, snakes, hawks and cats that hunt them. A cozy, chaotic auto-battler RPG: fight on auto or call every move. No pay-to-win.

title: Police Station Simulator Demo
description: You’re in charge of a run-down police station. Will you manage to restore it to its former glory? Arm yourself with some coffee and donuts, because there's a lot of renovation and micro-management work to do!

title: Death Row Demo
description: İşkence odasında idama mahkum edildin! Üzerinize yaklaşan testereyi durdurmak için 2 kişilik co-op veya 4 kişilik 2v2 rekabetçi asimetrik bulmacaları çözmelisin. Konuşamayan rehber ve devre çözücü olarak zamanla yarış, idamdan kurtul!

title: Magnetic Catch Demo
description: A magnet fishing adventure about rusty scrap and hidden wonders. Clean your finds and upgrade your gear to explore murky city canals, countryside lakes, and forgotten places, where every pull brings a little surprise.

title: Mortuus Demo
description: A round-based co-op zombies FPS for 1 to 4 players. Survive endless hordes in brutalist procedurally generated map. Buy doors, hit the mystery box, upgrade your guns, and uncover the hidden ritual that wakes the Mother.

title: Pattern Ring Demo
description: A roguelike alignment deck builder. Where you align your runes to cast spells to defeat enemies. Build your deck and craft your spells to meet the challenges ahead. Feed and grow your companion to aid in battle. Before it's too late, journey to the center of the maze and restore the Pattern Ring.

title: Whispering Green Demo
description: Grow rare magical plants, explore enchanted woods, and brew remedies for a growing world of customers. Build your apothecary's reputation by discovering rare flora and supplying the potions and medicines people need.

title: Tidy Up Together: Banknotes Demo
description: Try Tidy Up Together: Banknotes. Pick up scattered bundles, recognize each design, and place matching notes in any open spot on their shelf. Learn sorting tools as you go, then tidy the shop on your own or with friends.

title: Astro Company Demo
description: Build the path. Defend the Core. Combine towers, cards, and artifacts into broken synergies in an endless tower defense roguelike.

title: Drift Defense Demo
description: Defend a fragile base against waves of enemies drifting in on floating islands. Merge defeated isles into your main island to grow your front line, draft soldiers and buildings in limited deck slots, then spend gold to buy and deploy troops. Unique map effects add fresh tactical twists.

title: Elixir of Immortality DEMO
description: A cultivation incremental game where alchemy is the key to survival. Recruit minions, manage your alchemy room, seek elixirs to extend your lifespan, and reincarnate when your time runs out. Reincarnate again and again on your path to immortality.

title: Desting Clash demo
description: "Desting Clash" is a roguelike card game similar to Monster Train, where you will control heroes from different countries and eras, build your deck and hero team, challenge numerous monster levels, and become the strongest Fatebearer!

title: Take This Thing Out Of Me Demo
Tales of Twin Souls Demo
description: "Tales of Two Souls" is a 2D open-world xianxia RPG. Explore, fight, and cultivate with the soul bound to you. Uncover your family's fall, rebuild your ancestral home, meet allies and rivals, and forge your own path.

title: YinYangYokaiDemo
description: Creature collection + text AVG + adventure! Catch 200+ unique yokai, meet distinct companions in a story of conflicts, feelings and secrets. Kincyo, town of human-yokai harmony, is in crisis. Team up with Miumiu to expose the villain—you hold its fate.

title: Orebital Dynamics Demo
description: A puzzly space‑mining incremental where you command snake-like drills through grids of space rock. At Orebital Dynamics, your job is to mine rare resources and bring every drill home safely.

title: Seikyu Let's Go! Demo
description: A 1-4 player campervan trip through a newly opened wilderness park. This co-op demo gives you your first taste of adventure in the land of Seikyu, letting you create your character and set out across the first biome. Snap photos, cook around the campfire, and solve problems together!

title: Turing Game Demo
description: Play the Turing Game demo: blend in with AI-driven animals, question suspicious answers, vote on hidden identities and survive the night. A multiplayer social-deduction game where acting like an AI may be your best disguise.

title: Zero Contact Demo
description: This is a first-person shooter with roguelike, tower defense and horde-survival gameplay. Before extraction time arrives, use all available resources and obstacles to build defenses, block enemy advances and protect yourself, fend off wave after wave of monster attacks.

title: Droian - Training Ground
description: You play as an I.A.N rover as Colin the engineer trains you for your upcoming mission. This was totally not rushed at all and you are 100% ready for this mission. Discover X-corps mission, explore their training warehouses and uncover the secrets of this universe on the brink of collapse.

title: ORECATRAZ Demo
description: Free demo of Orecatraz: you're a prisoner on a mining colony, paying off your sentence in ore. Blast a giant rock apart in frantic 30-second shifts, grab every chunk before your oxygen runs out and upgrade your gear across the first 3 biomes.

title: Blue Remembered Hills: A Miscellany of Wayfarers from Yeyu Demo
description: Blue Remembered Hills: A Miscellany of Wayfarers from Yeyu is a narrative management game set in southwestern China during the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period. You keep a mountain inn—running the business, receiving travelers, and witnessing and shaping their stories.

title: A Pond Hunt Demo
description: Can you profit from draining ponds for fish? Hard to say! Start with muddy puddles, lease carp ponds, giant lakes, and turtle ponds. Build your empire and conquer the Dragon Pool for its treasure. What? Loch Ness? Drain it and find out!

title: Hotel Carnivalia Demo
description: Hotel Carnivalia is a first-person social deduction game for 4-15 players. Roam a gothic hotel on foot, hunt your prey as a predator, or follow the traces left behind to find the predators hiding among you.

title: 打検士 -DAKENSHI- Demo
description: Demo: can you tell by sound alone? On a cannery inspection line, tap each passing can with your inspection rod and listen for the tiny pitch difference that gives away spoiled food, then knock it down the chute. Headphones or earbuds strongly recommended.

title: 1999 TOKOYO Building Demo
description: 1999. The protagonist, a boy named Akira, finds himself lost in the TOKOYO Building—an indoor amusement park filled with secrets and eerie rumors. There, he begins living and working alongside its peculiar staff, but... did you know? People disappear in the TOKOYO Building.

title: 2034 Demo
description: 2034 is a near-future dystopian narrative adventure set in a paper-crafted world. Players explore idyllic towns, solve puzzles, and uncover deep conspiracies. Its signature origami art blends bright visuals with a cold dystopian core, and your choices shape the story and characters’ fates.

title: Winnie The Pooh Redux: Halloween Survivors Demo
Frontier Tavern Demo
description: Run a tavern in the Old West in this first-person demo. Pour drinks, serve customers, restock supplies and hire your first employees. Unlock whisky, improve your tavern and learn to defend it. Keep playing after completing the demo's missions.

title: Soundway Demo
description: Ride your own music. This demo turns five tracks from the Soundway soundtrack — and two songs from your own library — into neon roller coasters racing through deep space, where every climb, drop, and turn is shaped by the music itself.

title: PITCHFORK Demo
description: An online co-op dungeon crawler where up to 4 unqualified peasants climb an ever-changing castle to slay the local vampire. Fight monsters, solve puzzles, avoid traps, and make sure somebody keeps that torch lit.

title: Catomi: Suika Roguelike Demo
description: Turn cute cat-fruit into huge combos. Collect powerful catalysts that twist the rules, boost your multipliers, and change how you play. Drop or slingshot fruit into place, trigger chain reactions, and build powerful combinations that send your score soaring in this Suika-style roguelike.

title: Tick & Tired Demo
description: Tick & Tired is an incremental game about overcoming your to-do list. Complete short desktop tasks like sorting emails and organizing files, hire interns to automate the work and get massive combos at the end of the day to upgrade your workflow in a skill tree.

title: ARKEVIL Demo
description: A frenetic action-shooter inspired by the arcade classic *Super Pang*! Battle floating heads—skulls, zombies, and vampires—and collect bonuses. Use a wide array of weapons and power-ups to progress through increasingly challenging levels. Features hand-painted graphics and a Rock-Punk soundtrack.

title: Seven Nights Ghost 2 Demo
description: "This Love, This Curse — Only 7 Days Left" Live together with a flashy ghost girl for seven days—and survive her over-the-top love attacks. A stylish, slightly dark, yet heartfelt horror romance about youth, fear, and self-control.

title: Lunadra: Luna Awakens the Legendary Dragon Demo
description: A survivors-like roguelite action RPG where you master the power to grow giant or shrink tiny. Build your character by collecting weapons and companions, then challenge colossal legendary monsters. Supports 2-player local co-op.

title: Nostalgia Game Shop: Tidy Up Demo
Cure The Dead Demo
description: Run a Pharmacy for the infected, brew and mix cures and protect your inventory. Scavenge for resources, stock up the shelves and improve your store. You might have a cure but that doesn't mean you're safe from looters and hungry zombies. Grow your team to protect your store.

title: Another Cat`s Tale - Demo
description: This demo contains the opening section of Another Cat’s Tale. Explore the cursed house, solve puzzles, search for useful items, uncover its stories, and get a first look at the dark fairy-tale world of the full game.

title: DedRep Demo
description: Jump straight into the heart of the action. Whether you prefer to stay calm and plan your moves or turn everything into absolute chaos, play at your own pace and create your own rhythm. Unlock a variety of new abilities, grow stronger,and turn the battlefield into bloody mess.

title: Homelessness isn't an option Demo
description: Homelessness isn't an Option is a game about Managing your Business, and earning Money from Selling goods and Bargaining

title: Pandora's Lantern Demo
description: Experience the opening of Pandora’s Lantern, a dark-fantasy 2D action-adventure platformer. Explore mysterious environments, overcome hazards, solve light-based puzzles, and discover the first steps of Pandora’s journey.

title: Hearty Haven: Amalgamated Demo
description: Hearty Henrys back and he's stronger than ever along with his pals Moody Moo and Silly Sam! An upgraded magnet watch and so much more! Fight your way down to the depths of this facility while trying to keep your body in one piece. Nearly 4 times longer than the first game!

title: Texas Oil Baron Demo
description: Play the first 10 days of Texas Oil Baron. You inherit a patch of Texas and a letter from a man named Tex. Read the sonar, steer a drill into an oil deposit hidden in the cross-section, pump it, haul it and sell when the price is right.

title: Zombie Day Protocol Demo
description: Activate beacons, summon the zombies, and shoot your way out! Play the first 15 days of Zombie Day Protocol in this demo. Fight zombies, return to the train, and shape your build.

title: War Company: Fortress Europe Demo
description: Lead armies across a dynamic 3D campaign, then command the battles they create in real time. Logistics, maneuver, and tactical success combine to decide the fate of the war.

title: Here's My Target Demo
description: Contract killing is just another public service. As a regulator, it's your job to review the documents, listen to the client, and decide the fate of every target, then hope you made the right call.

title: Delvers' Guild Demo
description: An incremental game where you lead a dungeon delvers' guild. Upgrade your delvers' skills, unlock new classes and powerful Guild Master abilities to delve deeper into dangerous dungeons and uncover greater treasures.

title: Steal & Sell Simulator Demo
description: Steal valuable goods at night and sell them for a profit during the day. Start small, grow your business, and take on bigger, riskier jobs as the police close in. Invest in your shop, unlock new opportunities, and build a more efficient operation with every successful theft.

title: Omah Batik Demo
description: Experience the beginning of a heartfelt journey in the Omah Batik Demo! Return to Yogyakarta as Laras to save her grandfather’s batik house. Play through Chapter 1, master the art of canting, serve your first customers, and rediscover traditional craftsmanship in this casual arcade adventure.

title: All-in Tide Demo
description: Adapt to the ever-changing weather. Learn every cave along the shore. Swing your shovel and dig up whatever the sea has hidden. But never lose sight of your own desires — they can drive you mad, or make you filthy rich.

title: SHEEP HAPPENS Demo
description: This is coop multiplayer for 2 to 4 players, and every match the game decides who's who — one of you holds the ranch together, the rest exist purely to take it apart.

title: Dungeon Drawlers Demo
description: Dungeon Drawlers is a turn-based puzzle game where every step could be your last. Carefully plan your path and defeat your enemies in the fewest turns possible. Combine the skills of your 2 characters on this journey where each room is a unique puzzle.

title: Pawtings! Hidden Dogs Demo
description: Find hidden dogs in real museum paintings. Explore dozens of artworks, spot the hand-drawn dogs hiding in the details, and watch the color come back into each canvas. Play solo or hunt with up to three friends in a split screen or online. Enjoy a relaxing hidden-object game set to classical music.

title: Concrete Polishing Simulator Demo
description: Start your concrete polishing business and learn the trade in this hands-on first-person demo. Complete contractor training, operate professional equipment, and transform two rough concrete slabs into something beautiful through grinding, polishing, staining, and sealing.

title: Goldrot Demo
description: A tower defense where you command your subjects, man defenses, and manage resources. Keep production running, or your towers become useless.

title: Monkeys Don't Fear Hell Demo
description: A cozy farming and building sim by day, a demon-slaying gauntlet by night - grow crops, raise a town and then descend to battle waves of demons and towering bosses. DOOM & Vampire Survivors meets Stardew Valley.

title: Rip It! Card Collector Demo
description: A single-player incremental game where you hunt down 1,809 collectible trading cards. Sell dupes and upgrade your retro-futuristic gear to pull more cards, quicker! Enjoy the satisfaction of ripping packs, filling your binder, and completing the ultimate card collection. It’s time to get cracking!

title: Ridiculous Space Battles Demo
description: RIDICULOUS SPACE BATTLES is the spiritual successor to the first ever autobattler game: Gratuitous Space Battles! After a fifteen year wait, the ridiculously over-the-top and completely unjustified battles in space ARE BACK.

title: Wizard of Maths Demo
description: Conquer your maths anxiety and build numerical confidence through fun and challenging quests! Wizard of Maths is a JRPG-inspired, research-backed arithmetic adventure that helps you unlock your inner “human calculator,” whether you’re a child learning the basics or an adult sharpening your skills.

title: Another World: Guild Master I - Demo
description: Another World: Guild Master I is a strategy game built on spell construction, where verb order changes a spell's effect, not just its strength. Missions state their requirements openly. No real-time combat to execute — outcomes are decided by preparation, not reflexes.

title: Hearsay Demo
description: A free taste of Hearsay. Fourteen real recordings from the Library of Congress, cut into 61 unlabeled tapes and scattered around a basement archive. Four cabinets, from Marches & Bands to Popular Favorites. No labels, no search. Sort them by ear and make each one whole again.

title: Cursed Gas Station Demo
description: At an isolated gas station in the 1990s, Cole takes a night-shift job that comes with a room to stay in. As you serve customers, unexplained events begin to unfold in this psychological horror game.

title: Theos: Cities Of Myth Demo
description: Rise as the ruler of Athens, meet your citizens’ needs, and found a city worthy of the Gods. In Theos: Cities of Myth’s Demo, you’ll have a taste of the first 3 chapters of the Athens adventure, with Athena or Dionysus as your patron deities.

title: Fantasy Blacksmith Simulator Demo
description: Become a Master Blacksmith in this cozy fantasy simulator. Restore and upgrade your workshop, forge magical weapons and armor, craft jewelry, and enchant powerful gear. Meet magical creatures and mysterious figures as you enjoy a relaxing crafting experience, solo or with friends in co-op.

title: WHO THE HELL OPENED THE PORTAL?! Demo
Sheeping In Demo
description: The alarm went off. You hit snooze. Now you have five more minutes, a meadow full of sheep, and a shepherd's crook — count them over the fence, earn sleep, and buy your way to one more snooze. A cozy idle game about refusing to get up.

title: Nidgets: Award Winning Idle Simulator Demo
description: A screensaver with a body count. No progression, no ending, and it has won no awards. Spawn Nidgets, grab lightsabers, and walk away while they slaughter each other.

title: Grass Demo
description: Grab your tools and team up in a cozy co-op or solo lawn care simulator focused on smooth, satisfying teamwork. Mow, trim, water, burn, and clean up sprawling properties as you improve the neighborhood and climb the mower app rankings.

title: Incremental Ants Demo
description: Hatch ants. Explore parks. Steal picnic baskets. Incremental Ants is a game about growing an ant colony. Gather food using a variety of ants, upgrade their skills, unlock new species, and expand into territory where no ant has gone before.

title: Reapers' Tide Demo
description: Free demo of Reapers' Tide. Hold the Forsaken Graveyard as the Hooded Rogue or the Bone Necromancer, build your arsenal from level-up cards, crush the Lich King and the Bone Colossus, and break the Lich Emperor at 15:00. Your progress carries over to the full game.

title: GreeDrill Demo
description: Play the free GreeDrill demoYou owe the Company $2,000,000. Pay it back in ore, one quota at a time, and decide every cell: drill deeper for more, or surface before the crash.In the demo2 worlds: the Earthlands and the Desert2 Guardians to beat: the Vein Worm and the Eye of the WindThe Bailiff, contracts, the camp and the first Company...

title: Tailor Hotel Demo
description: Tailor Hotel is a management simulation game where you build and run your very own one-of-a-kind hotel.

title: Chad Billionaire Demo
description: Start broke. Work terrible jobs. Put that cash to work in real estate, businesses, and acquisitions until you hit your first million. That's where Chad Millionaire ends and Chad Billionaire begins. Your save carries over. The numbers are exaggerated. The financial logic underneath them isn't.

title: Red Rising Demo
description: Fight for dominance with up to 6 players in the official digital adaptation of the award-winning board game. Assemble a hand of followers, chain together powerful combos, and lead your house to victory in this clash of cards set in the dystopian world of Red Rising.

title: Ball Busters Demo
description: An over-the-top 3D arena roguelike where every hit counts. Chain insane combos, unlock wild fighters, and build game-breaking synergies—until you drop the ball.

title: Spray to Grail Demo
description: Spray-paint sneakers layer by layer, finish fast orders, and turn a scrappy bootleg studio into a rare-drop machine. Unlock wild grails, upgrade your gear, fill your collection wall, and chase the perfect pair in this juicy incremental game.

title: Hyperlane Highway Demo
description: Surf neon hyperlanes on a hoverboard by leaning your actual body. Dodge rogue bot fire while building a sponsored loadout from 60 plus mods. Every run is broadcast. Every death is monetized. Push deeper each time or give the fans what they want.

title: Expedition of the Guild Demo
description: Lead your guild into epic raid battles! Recruit heroes from different classes, build your own team, and challenge powerful bosses with unique mechanics. Unlock talent trees, collect endgame gear, and grow from a small squad into the strongest guild. Relive the golden age of MMORPGs!

title: Ratocalypse Demo
description: A strategy RPG where you design the AI of your characters! The prince of a fallen kingdom, ruined by a zombie plague, investigates the capital overrun with the undead in search of hope to resolve the crisis.

title: Squomb Demo
description: Too close. Too late. You drop a bomb. Boom. You die. They die. Good. Respawn as your squomb and dive back in. 1–4 players. PvP or Co-op. Fast, explosive 1-bit madness inspired by Bomberman.

title: Starlight Cove Demo
description: Cast your line, catch fish, and watch the numbers go up! Upgrade your gear, reel in bigger catches, and rebuild Starlight Cove in this cozy fishing incremental. Just one more fish, one more upgrade… and maybe you’ll finally help Grandpa catch the four legendary fish that have eluded him for years.

title: Tax Empire Demo
description: Build your own Tax Empire! Collect taxes, expand your city, hire tax officers, control traffic, enact new policies and squeeze out as much revenue as you can on your road to riches.

title: Trash & Infinite: Dungeon Card Demo
description: This is a strategic Rogue-like deck-building game. In the Tavern, watch your score soar and rake in piles of gold after playing your cards. In the Dungeon, use strategy and deck-building to combine over 100 minions and items to defeat over 100 monsters with unique skills.

title: SuperNatural Market: Sell or Die Demo
description: Run a supernatural supermarket serving zombies and vampires! In this demo, stock your shelves, set your prices, and work the checkout. Receive UFO deliveries, stop goblin thieves with your shoe, and keep your shop running.

title: Defend The HexCore Demo
description: Fast-Paced Tower Defense Game Where Space Is Used To Manipulate Enemy Behavior | Towers And Upgrades Take Up Space On The Board | Make The Enemy Decide Whether They Should Attack The Tower, Or Go Around!

title: Purpose of Visit Demo
description: Days 1 to 3 of Purpose of Visit, free. Their papers say one thing. Their answers say another. Question travellers at a border booth, drag the lie they just told onto the document it contradicts, and find the spy on clean papers before the evening news does.

title: Farmbound Demo
description: An addictive idle farming simulation where you build a massive agricultural empire from a single wheat plot. Harvest crops, adopt cute animals, automate production, unlock powerful skills, and prestige to multiply your yields into astronomical profits.

title: 巫师牌《Wizard Cards》 Demo
description: The free Wizard Cards Demo spans three acts, nine battles and three bosses. Combine class cards, tactics, blessings and card growth into different builds. Discover synergies in random shops and make each play and purchase shape the deck you take into battle.

title: Grandpa Golf Demo
description: A golf roguelike about making really big numbers. Sink shots, buy powerful items, and build ridiculous score combos as you push deeper into Grandpa Golf’s golf course.

title: BUZZ or DIE Demo
description: The rules are simple. Dive into your opponent's mindscape and search for secrets. Turn those secrets into content and make a short video. Gain the most Likes from the audience to win.

title: Spice & Grill Demo
description: Welcome to Spice & Grill, a cozy restaurant that lives at the bottom of your screen. Build and decorate your own dining space, set up the best kitchen, and train the best chefs to serve customers all year round.

title: Risk it Little Biscuit Demo
description: Risk it, little biscuit! Crunch through endless hordes of sugar-crazed sweets in this bite-sized bullet-heaven roguelite. Pick a hero from the pantry, stack absurd snack weapons, evolve them into pure kitchen chaos and topple crowned bosses, one crumbly run at a time.

title: We Build Below Demo
description: Get rich or get eaten. Build underground factories, automate production, and defend against parasites in this 1-3 player roguelite.

title: Blue Water Builders Demo
description: Blue Water Builders is a shipyard management and shipbuilding game set during the golden age of industry. Design, build, launch and manage your own fleet as you take a small shipyard from its humble beginnings to a major force in the world of shipbuilding. So, how far will you take your shipyard?

title: Alien Archeologist Demo
description: Alien Archeologist is a chill incremental digging game. Use a variety of upgradeable tools to mine ore, blast through earth, and clean strange artifacts as you journey yet deeper toward the mystery hiding at the planet's core.

title: Gospel Drift Demo
description: Demons have no manners, but Grandma doesn’t mind, and she doesn’t brake either. Drift over demons, crush them under your wheels, harvest souls, upgrade, and become unstoppable.

title: Typopus Demo
description: As an Octochef, master your typing skills to manage and serve dishes in a conveyor belt restaurant. Type to cook, type to upgrade, type to automate in Typopus, an incremental cooking game. Satisfy customers, unlock new meals and optimize your restaurant.

title: Kaizen Kitchen: A Restaurant Simulator Demo
description: Open a restaurant in the heart of a cozy little Japanese town. Cook authentic Japanese dishes, serve hungry customers, and experience the first taste of running your own restaurant!

title: ASUKA x Redline Reverie Demo
description: Play as Asuka Sakai and take on the mountain roads of Japan. Tune your car, challenge rival racers, climb the rankings, and earn your place at GRACE. A pure touge racing experience.

title: Handle With Care Demo
description: Handle With Care is a chaotic 1–4 player co-op physics game where tiny workers transport unstable bombs through a giant world. Work together, load the van, survive the hazards, and get the bomb home before time runs out.

title: Idle Reef Demo
description: Transform a barren seabed into a vibrant, colorful coral reef! Manage your resources to unlock new marine species, grow your ecosystem, and build your ultimate underwater paradise while listening to soothing soundtracks.

title: Cash Only Demo
description: Run a coffee shop by day and a drug business on the side. Serve customers, grow product, negotiate dead drops, avoid the cops, and split the work with friends in this co-op crime simulator.

title: Dice Knight Demo
description: Dice knight is a dice builder rouge like. Roll for numbers and use those numbers on different actions. Discover food items of power, and become the Dice Knight!

title: University of Progress Demo
description: Fully voiced, choice-driven Visual Novel. Instead of playing as a boring guy who is designed to be compatible with everyone, what if you played as an abrasive young man who isn't compatible with anyone and usually ends up making things worse? Meet Millard. He's kind of a dickhead.

title: ISKRA Demo
description: You take on the role of Alice, who wanders through a dark forest in search of a way out. On her journey she meets many figures — each one a reflection of her own personality, an echo of her fears, and a manifestation of her subconscious.

title: Here Comes the Horde Demo
description: Here Comes the Horde is an auto-battler incremental game where your loyal soldiers fight against hordes of undead enemies led by a formidable necromancer. Play this demo for the taste of the full experience and try yourself out in the first 7 levels of the game.

title: Plague Lords Demo
description: A turn-based tactical party RPG with base building, set during the Black Death. Assemble peasants, craftsmen, and warriors, investigate the plague's mysterious origin, develop your settlement, and fight the infected as disease consumes medieval Europe.

title: STARHOME Demo
description: Take command of a fleet carrying the last survivors of your civilization. Manage limited space aboard your ships, balance living quarters, production, defenses, and weapons, and explore an unknown galaxy in search of a new home. Play the STARHOME Demo.

title: Squabblin Goblins Demo
description: A chaotic multiplayer deckbuilding PvP with GOBLINS. Grab items, throw them at your friends, and craft a goblin so broken your friends will hate you.
developer: André Correia, Isaac Cerejo, Manyllines, Pedro Brito, João Santos, Rita Moutinho

title: Taptown Funk Demo
description: Taptown Funk is a groovy incremental rhythm game about growing a tiny funky town into a booming city. Hover to build, tap to the beat, catch coin combos & feel the heat. When the music stops, disaster detonates. Upgrade, rebuild or just automate! Can you find the groove, or will Taptown Funk you up?

title: Playrooms Demo
description: Thousands of balls are scattered throughout the playrooms. Someone should put them away, and there's no one here but you. Almost no one.

title: Benny's Backrooms Demo
description: A co-op horror where you and your friends (if applicable) explore a seemingly infinite expanse of eerie creature-infested liminal spaces, armed only with a glorified vacuum and specialized equipment to help you locate and extract a rare substance in the name of science.

title: Korean Noodle House Demo
description: A Singleplayer cooking experience. Exploring Korean cooking recipes and culture in a cozy environment. Make customers happy with delicious dishes, gain experience and level up, earn achievements and discover pieces in the art gallery!

title: Coma Dreams Demo
description: Guide a wounded Marine through a nightmare born of his own coma, facing the horrors of war, scarce ammunition, puzzles, and dark labyrinths. Evade a colossal, relentless pursuer, overcome manifestations of his deepest psychological traumas at every stage, and help him wake up and return to reality.

title: Oh! my Table Demo
description: Become the ultimate food artist in Oh! my Table. This relaxing sandbox game lets you design mouth watering dishes, mix and match tableware, and master the art of sauce drizzling. Use the Camera Mode to capture and share your delicious masterpieces.

title: Deathly Delights Demo
description: Forge new friendships, banish the darkness, and illuminate your surroundings as you unravel the mysteries behind a town stuck in limbo during Hallows Eve.

title: Foundering Demo
description: A chat app you've never seen before appears on your desktop. The moment you open it, a girl in strange work clothes asks for your help. After a brief time together, another world begins to unfold through that little chat window.

title: Little Warrior Demo
description: The Tiny Warrior demo features early-game content, allowing players to experience the core combat, character progression, and level-based gameplay. Demo content may differ from the final release.

title: Sort On The Ball Demo
description: A cozy game about opening tons of capsules to sort and collect cute toy balls. Sort like you're on the ball!

title: PARRY IT Demo
description: A fast-paced 2D minimalist action platformer where every attack can be parried with precise timing.

title: ArkSeed Terraformery Demo
description: You are the last chance for humanity, Terraform, Build, Save Humanity one pixel at a time.

title: Too Much Baggage Demo
description: Ever wonder where your bags go after check-in? In Too Much Baggage, keeping the airport moving is your problem. Build and expand a network of belts, route bags through security, and adapt as your airport grows. How long can you keep the world’s baggage flowing?

title: Grid & Guilt Demo
description: A unique 7x7 grid-based turn-based puzzle roguelike! Defeating monsters spawns lava, and collecting items spawns spike traps on the next floor. Climb the tower of 'Guilt' with 4 unique classes where your own choices shape the dangerous terrain ahead!

title: Space Travelers Demo
description: Mine asteroids, trade minerals and explore the opening sectors of a relaxed 2D space sim, then pin it to your desktop as a live wallpaper. The demo covers the game's first act with no time limit, and your save carries over to the full game.

title: COOKBOT prelude
description: You've been placed as a standard pantry model COOKBOT on the pioneer ship Ruya. Your systems are malfunctioning. Cook, bake and pour while following recipes. The crew might talk to you. This is expected. Don't listen to them - you are just a machine. This is a demo for COOKBOT.

title: Depth Above Demo
description: An atmospheric horror game inspired by classics from the 2000s. Playing as William in his constant search for Lynn, he ventures into all kinds of obscure places. With Lynn's last note as a guide, his goal remains, taking him through many places with creatures and environments shaped by corruption.

title: Eulogy of an Insect Demo
description: Explore the first two puzzle-box dungeons of this hand-drawn RPG with reactive turn-based combat, where bizarre characters each play differently. In search of her father, Charlie has found herself in a world of surreal wonder and BUGS. Finding him is one thing. Leaving is another...

title: What a Shift! Demo
