Selkie's Salvage&Co. Demo
description: Selkie’s Salvage&Co. is a first-person physics based incremental fishing game. Your task is to clean up the flooded planet! Fish up scrap, grind all of it down and collect trinkets of the past. Expand your salvaging operation and go beyond!

title: Aquarium Days Demo
description: Aquarium Days is a cozy fish-collecting game with 60 adorable species, 117 appearances, and 18 aquarium scenes. Keep your aquarium in a small window on your desktop, or set it as an animated wallpaper.

description: Break the world, then build your own. Vestalborne is an open-world survival crafting RPG: mine, farm, build and destroy across a procedural world and the caves below, and fight the rising danger

title: Maker Circuit Demo
description: Learn Electronics Through Play! Build circuits, use LEDs, sensors, motors, and microcontrollers to solve engaging challenges in Maker Circuit. Test, make mistakes, improve your designs, and discover real-world electronics concepts through hands-on learning. Build. Experiment. Become a Maker.

title: Break Demo
description: BREAK is a novel team-based MOBA. Choose your position, master unique abilities, and compete in fast-paced multiplayer showdowns.

title: Time, Line - Demo
description: Limited to moving left and right, every step you take pushes time forward. Thread through minimalist environments and discover how much depth can exist on a single line.

title: Soulstonia - Demo
description: Recruit Summoners with minds of their own, train 20+ skills, summon creatures, and explore a living fantasy world. Take direct control anytime or let your party keep gathering, crafting, fighting, and growing while idle in this cozy RPG.

title: Silent Sonata: Dead Air Demo
description: Recover 8 corrupted recordings hidden on the dark web. Defend against hackers and the cult that wants to keep them hidden. Solve the puzzles and stay off the radar in this strategic, suspenseful horror game.

title: Dungeon Sweeper Plus Demo
description: Expand the world map by uncovering surrounding tiles, aiming to complete your in-game Encyclopedia. Just be careful not to step on dungeon tiles (landmines)!

title: DOCTRINEERS Demo
description: DOCTRINEERS is a turn-based strategy game where no two games are ever alike. Devise clever strategies, use unique doctrinal units, and adapt to new battlefields in a single-player campaign and online multiplayer.

title: Tower of Annihilation: Welcome to Hell Demo
description: Tower of Annihilation: Welcome to Hell is a roguelite dungeon-crawler where the only way to escape eternal damnation is to climb a seemingly endless, interdimensional tower filled with monsters and temptation. Reforge your soul and climb ever-higher, or become corrupted by the evils lurking within.

title: A Passing in the Night Demo
description: In the dead of night, Kai wakes from a dream. Walk aimlessly in a surreal town among apparitions, to escape reality, to pass the time. Time only matters to the living.

title: O2GETHER Demo
description: O2GETHER is a co-op survival game with one shared oxygen tank. Untether from it to scout, grab loot, or save a friend, but your air is on a countdown. Drift back in time, or black out. Haul the tank through wreckage, dodge the chaos, and reach the space station before air runs out.

title: SHIFU: Traffic Masters Demo
description: Drive the daily workhorse cars of 1990s China. Deliver fragile cargo, carry passengers, chase down criminals, and weave through streets full of traffic, bikes, and pedestrians. Every vehicle has real weight and handling, and every job changes your approach. Do you have what it takes to be a Shifu?

title: Butaro's Overtime Office Demo
description: A chill idle game about escaping the 9-to-5. Adopt Butaro, a burnt-out salaryman who lives anywhere on your desktop. Watch him slack off from his mind-numbing job, decorate his office, and upgrade his corporate skills while you work or relax. Will Butaro escape corporate burnout before you do?

title: Iman Demo
description: Play the first half of IMAN's introductory chapter: explore Rudi's apartment and the streets outside as strange disturbances creep closer, then face your first boss encounter against the Kuntilanak.

title: Cyan Moon - The Simulation Program Demo
description: An experimental simulation sandbox where you shape procedural growth, adjust rules and parameters, and watch complex visual patterns emerge from simple systems.

title: Money Makes Money: Historical Market Simulator Demo
文字刷宝录 Text Loot Codex Demo
Evons Demo
description: Evons is a highly strategic card game played on a grid. No written effects on the cards: everything comes down to position, stats, arrows, and their abilities. Take control of the board and win. Building your deck isn't enough, every match is a battle of positioning. Easy to learn, hard to master.

title: Medovox Demo
description: Play the Medovox demo! It's an atmospheric sandbox and farming simulator with cozy graphics powered by Unreal Engine 5. Buy cars, plant crops, and travel across a seamless open world. Experience the gameplay right now and add the full version of the game to your wishlist!

title: Atlas Proxima: Tether Demo
description: Stay in touch with earth as you travel the solar system, in this co-operative online multiplayer idler world filled with curated content to discover and play together.

title: Deadroll Demo
description: Roll dice to build poker hands, stack powerful combos, and beat crooked dealers in a dark casino roguelike.

title: Littermates Demo
description: Littermates is a 1 to 8 player co-op game about scrappy raccoons who steal a garbage truck! In this frantic physics game you use teamwork to juggle chaotic tasks, drive an unwieldy garbage truck through neighbourhoods, steal trash and treasures, dodge drones, and race to stay ahead of the sun.

title: GemSlasher Demo
description: GemSlasher is an action roguelite where every attack is built from gems. Combine Main Gems with Support Gems, merge duplicate gems to increase their star level, and create powerful builds capable of tearing through relentless waves of monsters.

title: Querni Demo
description: Querni is an elegant abstract strategy game. Move your numbered tiles, connect consecutive chains, and be the first to remove all your pieces. Play solo against the AI, locally for 2 players, or online via Steam Remote Play Together.

title: It’s Just 45 Seconds Demo
description: You are the cursor, and enemies can grab, punch, and throw you. Protect Bit in intense 45-second rounds, buy cards, and shape your deck in this action roguelite demo, where every attempt calls for a new plan.

title: Catch the Black Ace Demo
description: The Ace of Spades is your chance—and your curse. Hide your role, bluff your friends, and turn unsuspecting teammates against each other. Capture a bomb, empty your hand in the chaos, and claim victory and tribute. Ready to trust no one in Catch the Black Ace?

title: Slip Angle Demo
description: Arcade drift racing where being sideways is almost mandatory! Find the perfect balance between speed and angle to clear objectives and slide your way through multiple game modes. In the Slip Angle Demo, try out 6 cars, 3 courses, and multiple game modes and events.

title: Feeding Gooble Demo
description: Strap in to your chair and keep Gooble fed, or else! Combo foods, PROVIDE SYNERGY, and push your luck in this roguelite deckbuilder. Your demo progress rolls over to Early Access!

title: Cat and Dog: Princess Guardians Demo
description: Dark demons swept across the entire continent, and the princess embarked on the road of escape. Along the way, she encountered many cats and dogs that had been ostracized and abandoned by the world. In the end, these cats and dogs voluntarily transformed into guard towers to protect the princess

title: Mage's Adventure Demo
description: A roguelike auto battler of misfit heroes and warped realms. Recruit your party, defeat monsters for gear, hoard godly artifacts, and put down the colossal evils at the end of every road.

title: Blackbox Creations Demo
description: This is an AI-mechanic game. Blast your way through a machine-ruled world in this bullet-hell roguelite. Fuse skills with mechanics generated in real time. No two runs are ever the same — now go turn it all upside down!

title: Gloombo Demo
description: Gloombo is a cozy desktop companion who works while you focus. Turn your focus time into things she can craft, build up her floating island, fulfill orders, discover new blueprints, and look after a friend.

title: Deep Six Demo
description: A post-WW1 stealth action game where equipment is scarce, and time of day, weather, sound, movement, and position can all betray your position. Avoid, distract, knockout or kill as you traverse unique locations, sabotage war machines, save your comrades, and take down elite soldiers.

title: Slightly Used Sorcery Demo
description: Run a cozy magical pawnshop where you buy suspicious magical junk, uncover ridiculous enchantments, craft bizarre artifacts, haggle with eccentric customers, and turn magical trash into profit.

title: Xenogarden Demo
description: Play the Xenogarden demo and experience the core invasion loop: grow your alien network, assimilate structures, defend your heart, and survive escalating human attacks across the First Bloom tutorial and Final Bloom endless mode.

title: Ace & Aro: One Night Early
description: Welcome to the Ace & Aro Meetup! Oh, wait a minute...you're one night early! Well, since you came all this way, why not take a look around the barcade and try a cocktail? We could have a chat about the A spectrum or even try one of the arcade games!

title: Grid Demon Demo
description: Turn a cyberpunk machine swarm against itself in a fast top-down bullet-heaven roguelite. Hack enemies into temporary allies, install run-changing Neural Patches, unleash your Grid Demon Mode and break the Wardens guarding each deeper grid.

title: Public Faucet Hunt Demo
description: Dive into Public Faucet Hunt, an action arcade demo by Van Isle Games! Test your reflexes across a tutorial level, 3 showcase stages, and full difficulty settings. Master the mechanics now before taking on the 15+ levels of the full game!

title: MYRIORAMA Demo
description: MYRIORAMA is a top-down action-adventure game with a twist: solve puzzles and complete dungeons by rearranging the rooms of the dungeons themselves! Use reality-altering powers to reveal, reshape, and rebuild a stop-motion world full of beguiling mysteries and head-scratching puzzles.

title: PeeCee Critters Demo
description: PeeCee Critters is a desktop pet with a whole monster-collecting RPG inside it. This free demo is the first three of fourteen lands: your pet on the desktop, wild encounters, battles, your first evolution, your island and three alphas.

title: SLOP Demo
description: SLOP is a Co-op Comedy Horror Cooking game where 4 chefs cook the BIGGEST, SLOPPIEST meal possible to keep the Grubshaft running and reach the Final floor before you become SLOP

title: Neighborhood Watchers Demo
description: In Neighborhood Watchers, you fish, farm, and decorate with friends, then raid haunted houses to recover lost memories and rescue the spirit children who once called this sleepy suburb home.

title: Dark Inquiry - Profane Soil Demo
description: Investigate an abandoned farm where mysterious accidents have brought the construction of a luxury resort to a halt. Explore, solve puzzles, and uncover secrets buried beneath decades of silence.

title: The (mis)adventures of Magical Girl Luna Trial version
Idle Agency Demo
description: Run a struggling frontier agency in this single-player idle RPG. Recruit distinct heroes and build 4x4 formations. Automate commissions and forge gear as you push through an endless campaign where positioning morale and synergy decide every battle.

title: Grid Poker Demo
description: Grid Game is a roguelike deckbuilder. Master grid-linking strategies to unleash vastly different scoring potentials from the exact same divine card combo. Beat diverse bosses across changing poker layouts, and enjoy another layer of fun via casual asynchronous card swapping.

title: Last Stop Horror Hospital Demo
description: Avoid Mister Giggles a former mental patient who was obsessed with evil clowns and violent behavior. He feeds on illusion, traps, puzzles, and torment. Investigators in hazmat suits attack you and are under the influence of Mister Giggles.

title: My Oshi Uses Too Much Slang! Demo
description: Will your comment get picked up by your oshi? In "My Oshi Uses Too Much Slang!", you join the stream of a rookie VTuber who calls herself seiso but whose emotions spill right out. Read the room, drop the right slang, and she'll call your name. Comment fearlessly and carry your oshi to 1M subs!

title: Trivasion Demo
description: Survive against a swarm of geometric enemies and the bosses guarding your way forward in this fast, minimalist arcade survival game. Bounce, boost, and slide through the chaos, chain kills to build your multiplier, and chase the leaderboard. Simple to pick up, brutal to master.

title: The Drawratos Demo
description: You’re a rat who plays poker. Draw on your cards, cheat your way to victory, and outplay your rivals in wild poker games for up to 4 players. Here, the winner isn’t the one with the best cards, but the one who proudly says, “Yeah, I’m a rat!”

title: Underveil Demo
description: Experience a new roguelike deckbuilder with no Energy and Spatial Strategy. Your board is your Energy. Expand your board and engrave powerful effects. Fuse two cards to create new ones, then rotate and place them in limited space. Build your cards, shape your board, and make it uniquely yours.

title: HellRock Diver Demo
description: Dig through Hell. Kill the horde. Choose your power. Descend deeper. A roguelike shooter-platformer where the ground is your weapon and every boss kill makes you stronger.

title: かみひより ～識塗り編～ 体験版
Epic Seven Demo
description: PLAY THE ANIMATION! A playable anime in your hands, Epic Seven. A turn-based Hero collection RPG alive with stunning 2D visuals. Collect unique Heroes in the Seventh World and plan your path to victory through elemental effects and skill combinations. Challenge Heirs worldwide in World Arena PvP.

title: Pedal Pedal Pedal Demo
description: A chaotic physics racer where two tiny riders share one oversized BMX. Each pumps, steers and brakes, and the bike only goes where you both agree.

title: Football on Paper Demo
description: A simultaneous turn-based football game. You talk big. Draw the next minute. Watch your boys run it. Guess what the other manager will do — because they are guessing you.

title: MirrorBullet Demo
description: An unreflected shot cannot kill anything. Place mirrors, fire once, and read the enemy volley as a route through the board. The demo includes all 36 stages of Sector 01, with deterministic puzzles, prediction lines, and shards to collect. No timing, luck, or hints - only the answer you can see.

title: Haunted House Demo
description: You wake in an old house you cannot leave, your wife Alice beside you. Pick up the oil lamp and open the first door on the ground floor. Things wander the hallways: some chase you, some watch you pass, some blow out your lamp. The free Haunted House demo covers the ground floor and the playground.
developer: 改變娛樂工作室, 哈皮

title: Rogue's Odyssey Demo
description: Explore, Grind, Loot, Die, and repeat! Face hordes of monsters and challenging bosses in a 2.5D co-op roguelike ARPG. Combine skills across classes, creating thousands of unique builds, such as a potion-brewing Warrior or a wizardry Cat, the choice is yours!

title: Crow Hunts Worms Demo
description: An Action Incremental/Roguelite Puzzle where you Aim, Shoot, and utilize Gun Skills to annihilate worms! Upgrade your guns and get temporary upgrades while playing and clear infested areas OR play endlessly!

title: Clearance Defence Demo
description: Hold the shop for the first three nights of Clearance Defence. The gnomes come for the clearance aisle after dark, and you build a maze of make-do towers out of whatever's on the shelves to keep them off it until morning. Clear a night and its Endless Mode opens, so you can find out how long you can keep the place standing.

title: Void Skirmisher Demo
description: The free demo of VOID SKIRMISHER, an arcade co-op shooter for up to 8 players: jump the warp gate, hold off endless waves of hostile fleets far past any front line and drop in or out whenever you like. 40 levels, five bosses – and your progress carries over.

title: ShootyCraft Demo
description: Massive online space battles with building and crafting. Up to 100 players in an arena. Solo and team game modes.

title: Wight Butterfly Demo
description: Recover your stolen VAMPIRE MECHA POWER CHASSIS suits from 6 deadly monsters sent by your brother, Dark Moth. Toggle through elemental suits and custom Blaster configurations in this punishing retro 8-bit shooter. Earn mobility upgrades from the Reaper and collect what was stolen from you. GO!

title: Galactic Disharmony Demo
description: A Sci-fi First-person shooter and Strategy game. Command and control your fleets and planets, build troops and extract resources in the solar maps' turn-based strategic mode. Then head into battle with your troops in large-scale first-person warfare to conquer planets.

title: Codename: Operation Go Demo
description: Codename: Operation Go is a turn-based strategy game that blends the rules of Go and the playstyle of strategy games. As in Go, players can deploy units directly to any available position on the battlefield, send them into action immediately, and capture enemy forces outright by surrounding them.

title: SeverLink Prototype
description: SeverLink is a retro stealth action, inspired by the console classics of the early 2000s like Splinter Cell, MGS2-3 and Hitman Contracts. With the art direction emulating the distinct look of the Playstation 2 library of games.

title: Fate Candle: Three Kingdoms - Chronicle Restored Demo
JOVA Demo
description: Try Jova free. Line up four or more Jovials to clear them, wipe out every Baddie, and don't let the box fill up. This demo includes the first 15 story levels and Endless mode through Wave 10 - see how far you can get in the full version!

title: Fuman Ghoul Demo
description: The Fuman Ghoul demo includes all the core systems of the full game, such as running stages and outfit changes, alongside a unique demo-only mini story.The demo's estimated playtime is roughly 20-25 minutes long, including a tutorial, while the full game is expected to take roughly 3-5 hours to complete.

title: (Don't) Hear Demo
description: Responding to a late night call, a police officer discovers a hidden elevator in the woods leading to Resonance Laboratories. Trapped in a subterranean hell where sound experiments shattered reality, your only rule for survival is simple: (Don't) Hear

title: YokaiRun Demo
description: "Xun Yao" is a Chinese-style 2D theatrical action game with unique world-building and dramatic storytelling. —Help! Master's away, demons are loose! Can the Demon Patrol's most unreliable apprentice fix this? No godlike moves—just half-baked talismans and rusty martial arts. Redeem yourself!

title: Medium Rare Demo
description: Free demo. Eat people and conserve ammo as you hike to the top of a mountain where a human meat factory is about to process your kidnapped wife in this turn based survival dungeon crawler.
developer: Payne Robinson, Peter Tinaglia, Giovanni Fim

title: Pack or Die Demo
description: Manage your inventory case in a classic style as your character automatically advances through a post-apocalyptic world, fighting hordes of zombies with weapons and ammo you strategically organize.

title: Nick vs the Brick of Ick from space Demo
Thiccfoot Demo
description: A relaxing camping trip becomes a desperate struggle for survival. Will you survive? Will your friends? That all depends on you.

title: DABANGGU Demo
description: Play a complete round of Korean alleyway team tag with bots in Ikseon-dong. Run, disguise yourself as street props, outsmart the taggers, and break every captured teammate out of base.

title: Escape from Galgame Demo
description: Your company’s about to go public. Instead, you get isekai’d into a dating sim. Massive W? Meet Ada: mecha girl, antimatter engine, emotional damage. Repair her body, uncover her past, and choose your route in a dark romantic comedy where bad rizz gets bad endings.

title: Desktop Fireworks Festival Demo
description: Desktop Fireworks Festival is a management sim that lives at the bottom of your screen and stays out of your way while you work, launching the fireworks you designed into the sky above your desktop. Grow your festival into a grand venue and light up the sky with a show of your own!

title: Oekaki Golf Demo
description: 『Oekaki Golf』の体験版です。コース1,2の合計18ホールをソロプレイとオンラインの協力・対戦で遊べます。ホールエディターやユーザー作成ホール、その他のコースとカスタマイズの多くは製品版に収録されます。

title: Unharvest Demo
description: Drain the life from everything around you in this reverse-farming incremental game. Infect all that grows, upgrade your plagues, and wither the world until nothing living remains.

title: SWOM Demo
description: SWOM — a game where you survive after memory loss, using magic based on basic laws you discover during gameplay. Build shelters, explore the unexplored world, collect items and resources to survive and understand why you are here.

title: The Studio - Indie Grind Demo
description: A minimalist simple turn based 2D strategy simulation about building and launching an Indie game by an Indie team. Point, click and text based. No GPU required. Requires the Microsoft Edge browser to run.
developer: Jawwad Farid, Amin Farid, Irfan Kheiri, Fawzia Salahuddin, Agnes Paul

title: Paper Arena Battle Simulator Demo
description: Paper Arena is a battle simulator with hundreds of customizable AI fighters. Control one or watch the chaos unfold as rivalries, records, and history grow across matches.

title: Backrooms : The Threshold Demo
description: The Backrooms have been breached. Step through an experimental gateway into an endlessly generated labyrinth, film what you find, and follow the needle home. A free single player demo of The Backrooms: Threshold. Every expedition is somewhere no one has been.

title: The Idle Witch and Her Tower of BOOOOM! Demo
description: Be a witch, build a tower, and BOOOOM the attacking monsters in this short incremental RPG!

title: hunter x Demo
description: A thrilling low-poly action RPG focused on monster hunting. Explore dark fantasy worlds, engage in intense combat, collect unique weapons, and customize your character's stats to survive the ultimate hunt. Play the official demo now!

title: Heroll: IF Demo
description: Step into the unknown on a mysterious board full of surprises. Roll, spin, and loop. Everything depends on the hero's luck in this dynamic journey.

title: BEASTOPIA: RAIDERS Demo
description: Beastopia Raiders is a 2D PvPvE animal extraction shooter set after humanity’s extinction. Raid zombie-infested ruins, scavenge the machines humans left behind, build a refuge for your animal clan—and extract before the horde closes in.

title: The Cardian - Light the Shrines Demo
description: The Cardian is a tactical roguelike deckbuilding card-defense game where positioning is everything. Predict enemy movements, plan your path, and set your cards in advance. See the future, outsmart the swarm, and defend the last Shrines of Light!

title: We Roll at Dawn Demo
description: Build a floating island by day and defend its Sacred Tree by night in this action roguelite tower-defense game. Roll for new land, place elemental towers, fight as one of seven heroes, and carry permanent upgrades into each new run.

title: Pill & Chill Demo
description: Sort a tabletop full of colorful pills with a counting spatula. Pill & Chill is a relaxing, physics-based organizing game with no time limit, no score, and lots of satisfying little sounds.

title: Town defense TD
description: A survivor-like tower defense game. Freely plan your monster's route and creatively design your own defense positions from scratch！

title: Abby Normalli in Mayhem Mansion Demo
description: Explore a rubber-hose 3D collect-a-thon platformer where you swing a massive hammer, solve puzzles, uncover secrets, smash obstacles, and battle kooky family rivals across jazzy cartoon worlds filled with surprises.

title: Myth-OS Demo
description: Step into a limitless sandbox governed by a dynamic AI Game Master. Merge the total freedom of a Tabletop RPG with the mechanics of a Grand Strategy epic. Whether exploring dungeons or ruling empires, your choices ripple across a deep, living, and fully persistent universe.

title: Dragon Fields Demo
description: Live the simple life in this cozy game where you farm crops, go fishing, play music, raise and mutate dragons, and customize your character!

title: AJ's Anomaly Demo
description: Short narrative driven horror. Play as Amelia Jalisco, a fashion designer locked in her apartment. Hangout with your imaginary boyfriend, use your anomaly therapy device, and explore your dreamlike surroundings.

title: Supercar Collection Together Demo
description: Run your own diecast store alone or with up to 3 friends! Unbox surprise car packs, build your collection, race against customers, trade cards online, and grow your business together in this 1-4 player online co-op simulator.

title: Lynayly Demo
description: Lynayly is a cooperative, roguelike deck builder set in the mystical realm of Tovycri where four players build their own decks while exploring a new land built exclusively for real-time cooperative play. Team up and set forth on your journey to defeat the Gludites and save the world of Gichiman!

title: Yingtao Inn Demo
description: A story-driven visual novel. Inherit your grandmother's inn, tucked deep in the mountains — Yingtao Inn. Leave the city behind. The inn has no sign, yet wanderers find their way. Never ignore the one rule: be back before midnight. Yingtao Inn awaits.

title: 薪上人 Demo
description: This is a simulation management and development + romance adventure GalGame. As an unemployed individual short on funds, you encounter various girls while working part-time, sharing the hardships of survival and sparking emotional sparks amidst the mundane daily life.

title: Souls for Relics Demo
description: Free demo. An incremental roguelite auto-battler where you choose random relics, create powerful synergies, earn souls, and unlock new possibilities between runs.

title: Item TD Demo
description: In this tower defense game, play as a fighter alongside towers and a mage partner. This demo features 3 stages and 3 difficulties. Arrange items in inventories to maximize their power, develop your skill tree, and survive waves of challenging enemies.

title: Overwrite Conflict Demo
description: Shape placement meets turn-based roguelike deckbuilding. Rotate and deploy protocols to contest cells and limit rivals. Chain effects within limited turns to raise your tactical score and turn a lead into damage. Collect protocols, components and supplies on random routes to build around your mech.

title: Eternal Blade Demo
description: An open-world action RPG set in the Baransu Realm. Play as Emerald, the last of the Murakai Bloodline and daughter of Sensei Lux, fighting to gather the Almighty Gemstones, wield the Eternal Blade, and free her father from an eternal curse before chaos and darkness are unleashed on the realm.

title: Last Offer: Car Dealer Demo
description: Explore an open world, find cars for sale, inspect them, negotiate, buy, customize, and sell for profit. Build and grow your own dealership, deal with customers, and know when to make your last offer.

title: Trade or Threat Demo
description: Trade or Threat is a first-person shopkeeping and dungeon-crawling simulation where you sell goods by day and search for valuable loot after dark. Earn enough gold to repay your debt to the boss while balancing profit, danger, and the rules imposed on your shop.

title: Mr Chicken's Totally Ethical Farm! Demo
description: Embody Mr. Chicken on the journey to become the most profitable egg farm in the world, all whilst maintaining a totally ethical practice!

title: The Evil Rise Demo
description: The Harper house went dark three weeks ago. You were sent to find out why, and to keep it quiet. Every light inside is still burning. A first-person survival horror demo: ration your ammunition, open the house one lock at a time, and survive what is left of the people who lived here.

title: Let Me Die Demo
description: Let Me Die is a short incremental game about a hero trapped in a loop, fighting a monster. Every time you die, you gain the resources needed to push further. Turn death into power. Unlock upgrades, complete quests, create unique builds. Break the loop.

title: Sea Land Air: Four Nations War Demo
description: A four-player 2v2 hidden-information strategy game. Secretly deploy 33 land, naval and air pieces, scout with airships, and capture both flags of the opposing team.

title: THEORY WORKS: YOUR FRIENDS DON’T Demo
description: Outsmart your friends in a strategy party game for 3 or more players. The biggest pile of coins scores nothing! Scout, swap and rotate your way into a scoring spot, then hope you can keep it until the end. Built-in voice chat. Play the Coin Game in the demo.

title: Not Now, Aliens! Demo
description: Free Demo. The aliens have given humanity 8 hours before Earth is destroyed. Use a Gravity Gun to lift anything in the city, build your own path to the giant UFO, and save the planet solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players.

title: Lanebound Demo
description: Push one lane with up to 3 players in this co-op PvE MOBA. Pick a hero, clear waves, take towers, and crack the enemy core—no PvP, just teamwork. Demo includes the full match loop with Steam lobbies and friend invites.

title: Springs, Eternal Demo
description: Explore a mysterious hot springs in the dead of night and meet the other lost souls who are drawn to this place.

title: THE FATUM Demo
description: The Supreme Committee congratulates you on your promotion. Your task is to identify citizens infected by the unknown virus. Interrogate, inspect, pass a verdict. Test your deduction in a world of total control. Remember: the Standard above all.

title: Oink Splash Party Demo
description: A chaotic multiplayer party brawler where bouncy piggies battle across giant inflatable waterparks! Punch, bounce, and inflate your way to victory.

title: Another One Demo
description: Flip 7 cards for a massive boost or draw a card you already have and lose everything. Another One is a roguelike deckbuilder where no duplicates survive. 5 heroes, brutal bosses, and a Daily Challenge leaderboard that resets at midnight.

title: Maybe... I'll go to the beach Demo
JUST SHOVEL IT! Demo
description: The free demo: two zones of the yard, a shovel, a snow vacuum and a furnace. Just enough to find out whether this gets its hooks into you.

title: Below The Blades Demo
description: Climb, repair and survive Turbine 46 in a first-person horror game where every handhold matters. Survive a violent storm, manage your grip and stamina, and uncover what happened to the technician who came before you while trying not to get caught by what's crawling around the turbine.

title: Fork the Rich Demo
description: Billionaires should not exist. It's time to Fork the Rich!

title: Night of the Idle Horde Demo
description: An idle and incremental game and homage to B-movie horror classics. Watch your zombies march across your desktop, growing from a lowly Shambler into a massive horde, with help from little critters that march with them and automate Brain collection.

title: Doc Tommy: The Vig Demo
description: The free demo of Doc Tommy: The Vig. You owe the Doc ten grand: answer questions about Our Business to pay it down. Twenty questions from the real board, all six categories, every difficulty, in High Stakes or Open Play.

title: Studs Up! Win Ugly Demo
description: Score goals. Break bodies. Collect teeth.The free demo of Studs Up! Win Ugly, a top-down five-a-side football brawler where the pitch is questionable, the referee has his price, and your transfer budget is rattling around in somebody else's mouth. What's in the demoQuick Match against the AI. Win, and the next lot come out harder.

title: GOSSAMER DIVORCE Demo (Episode 1)
description: A demo containing the first episode of retro sci-fi mystery VN GOSSAMER DIVORCE, encompassing the first three ingame days of the week the full game spans. Episode 1 is roughly 4 - 6 hours (approx. 87k words) in length.

title: Squircle Demo
description: It goes in the square hole! Squircle is neon pinball meets crazy golf, and it's super cool (just trust me, okay). This demo packs in 30 Golf levels across 3 planets, plus Pinball Mode on Easy and Medium. Fire, bounce, sink, repeat.

title: CHESS2 Demo
description: CHESS, BUT...   NO TURNS,  NO CHECK OR CHECKMATE,  CAN'T MOVE THE SAME PIECE TWICE, 10×10 BOARD,  2 EXTRA KNIGHTS & PAWNS,  PAWNS MOVE IN ANY DIRECTION

title: GET HIM! Demo
description: IT'S FINALLY TIME TO BEAT ONE OF YOUR FRIENDS WITH YOUR FRIENDS! ONE GETS SELECTED. THE OTHERS BEAT HIM DOWN WITH PUNCHES, FURNITURE OR WEAPONS! BUT NEVER FORGET, YOU COULD BE THE ONE NEXT!

title: Lunar Crypt Demo
description: Save Chinese New Year in this zero-gravity precision platformer inspired by Chinese mythology. Explore a specially curated slice of the spirit world in this demo.

title: Check-In Anomaly Demo
description: Play one complete night shift at the hotel. Watch the cameras, report the anomalies, patrol the hallways and try to survive until 6:00 AM.

title: Music Manager Demo
description: This is the demo version of Music Manager. The demo lets you play for 18 in-game months. Demo save compatibility with the full game is planned where possible but cannot be guaranteed while the game is still in development. Major updates may make some demo saves incompatible with the full release.

title: Passion Demo
description: A detective. A mysterious dame. A town full of bad decisions. Passion is a story-driven JRPG with fast ATB combat, strange characters, sharp dialogue, and trouble waiting around every corner.

title: My Little Ranch Demo
description: A cozy horse ranch that lives on your desktop while you work, or in full screen when you don't. Feed your horses, send them running together, race for coins, hire ranch hands and grow your ranch.

title: Bumper & Thumper Demo
description: Chaotic vehicular combat roguelite. Choose your ride, ram through hundreds of robots, level up and stack weapons. Combine crazy upgrades to create the perfect build, face bosses and outrun the deadly robots. If you stop, you die.

title: XENO DEAD Demo
description: XENO DEAD is a fast-paced FPS tinged with a melancholic atmosphere. After aliens have come to the planet Earth to siphon its resources, the humans decide it best to call in their strongest weapon... you, the Assassin.

title: Citizen Pain II Demo
description: Citizen Pain II is a unique old-school first-person action RPG experience featuring insane challenge, fast gameplay intensity and instantly rewarding combat. Begin a dark journey and experience secret dungeons, hidden hazards and terrifyng enemy encounters.

title: Japan Scenic Puzzle Demo
description: Take a short puzzle journey through Okayama. Meet your guide, find 3 differences, complete a 25-piece jigsaw, and answer 3 quiz questions. This demo includes only Chapter 1 of the Chugoku journey.

title: Sergio the Wizard Demo
description: A roguelite bullet hell where you control Sergio the Wizard, a hot-headed rockstar shooting with his guitar down an endless highway. Collect resources, build the ultimate deck to supercharge your sound, and survive hordes of enemies while competing for the top of the global leaderboard!

title: Too Deep To Stop Demo
description: Break dirt, drop treasure, and blow up whatever gets in the way. Too Deep To Stop is a physics-based incremental mining clicker where each haul pays for stronger hits, stranger tools, and a bigger mess on the next run.

title: BALLRENA Demo
description: BALLRENA Demo is a physics-driven build-crafting auto-battler roguelite. Choose a Core, buy, rotate, and merge oddly shaped parts, then fit them into a tight 5×5 grid. Send your custom ball into the arena and watch every collision, weapon trigger, and chain reaction put your decisions to the test.

title: Faryloopa Demo
description: Build the board. Play the cards. Roll the dice. Faryloopa is a roguelike deckbuilder meets boardbuilder where every run is a new layout, new synergies, and bigger scores to chase.

title: Blacksite Lazarus Demo
description: Sent to investigate a medical facility gone dark, a private military contractor discovers a nightmare of death and mutation. Explore, survive, and uncover the truth behind a cancer cure that created something far worse.

title: Paluah's Trench Demo
description: An underwater narrative horror game where you must journey to the bottom of a deep-sea trench and uncover its mysteries.

title: Desktop Factory Demo
description: Drill deep while you work or game in a zero-stress factory builder for the side of your screen or second monitor. Power your drill, unlock alternate building shapes, and master compact layouts as you harvest the galaxy. The. Factory. Must. Grow.

title: Drum Incremental Demo
description: Play the free demo of Drum Incremental, a rhythmic idle game where every click follows real drumming rudiments. Master the first two phases, upgrade your gear, and sync the music to your tempo.

title: DITY: Origins Demo
description: Autumn 1974. A cleaner from a forest parish is sent to town for soap. He speaks a language where "don't worry, I won't help you" means "I will" — and everyone hears a refusal. The beginning of the story.

title: Witch’s Atelier Demo
description: A cozy pixel-art adventure! Play as a young witch & apothecary in a heartwarming town. Secretly guard the peace: battle monsters, brew potions, farm, cook, and fish. Build bonds with villagers. Blending healing vibes with action, start your witchy life!

title: Battle Gaze Demo
description: Join the legendary warrior Battal in the official Battle Gaze Demo! Master fluid 2D hack-and-slash combat, unleash devastating sword and bow combos, and conquer challenging bosses in this action-packed prologue.

title: Broadband Architect Demo
description: This is the free demo of Broadband Architect. It is the real game on a smaller map: three real Gloucestershire towns — Bishops Cleeve with Woodmancote, Cheltenham and Tewkesbury — with every system switched on and no time limit.

title: Zorezdra Demo
description: Zorezdra is a sci-fi platformer/metroidvania with a retro graphical aesthetic. Run, jump, fight and glide your way through a vast starport as you search for the truth about your protagonist's complex origins.

title: Mulerun - Retro Bootlegger Simulator Free Game
description: Build a moonshine empire in the 1980s. Brew, bottle, deliver, and protect your cargo as you grow from a dusty village to Mulerun City. Outsmart your ankle monitor, take risky deals, and smuggle by land, sea, and air while caught between the CIA and the cartel. Solo or 4-player co-op.

title: No Love No Money Demo
description: Love or Money? Or maybe destroy both? No Love No Money is a comedy visual novel that starts out as as a school dating sim and ends with a socialist revolution. Or maybe not.

title: Iron & Arrow Demo
description: Fight through a fallen kingdom in this dark fantasy action roguelite demo. Build your weapons, defeat the undead, protect a caravan, hold the last defensive line, and storm a castle across four connected missions.

title: TAJRISH 1994 Demo
description: Someone's old computer. Tajrish Metro Underground, 1994. The video files on it aren't videos — they're tapes you walk through, first-person, as the person holding the camera. Read the files. Play the footage. Repair what's corrupted. What the damage was hiding is worse than the damage.
developer: Home Made Lemonade Games, Half-Baked Cake

title: Delving The Depths Demo
description: Escape imprisonment by delving into the caverns below your cell and exploring until your group reaches the surface in this first-person grid-based dungeon crawler with turn-based combat.

title: Octodefense Demo
description: Commandeer the galaxy's defense in OctoDefense, a sci-fi tower defense with 10+ hours of tactical action. Master shifting tentacle paths, level up your turrets, and crush colossal cosmic bosses to an epic synth soundtrack across campaign and survival bonus modes.

title: Sort My Comics ! Demo
description: Sort 250 comic books, rebuild collections, identify formats and bring order back to a chaotic comic shop. Unlock superpowers as you progress and discover the satisfying core of Sort My Comics! in this free demo.

title: BLASTARD! Demo
description: Blast your way through walls, enemies, and your own friends! Grow absurdly powerful by placing kegs, kicking them, leveling up, and stacking loot into wild builds as you fight your way through each run!

title: Nomads Plague Demo
description: Lead a band of Nomads through the plague-stricken Manecia in a real-time tactical survival game. Manage scarce resources, choose your routes, and command specialized survivors in brutal battles where wounds persist, death is permanent, and every decision carries forward.

title: Brewery Simulator Demo
description: Run a medieval tavern, grow ingredients, brew unique alcohols with custom flavor traits, and serve demanding customers. Expand your business, unlock new brewing tiers, and manage the tavern solo or with up to 4 players in online co-op.

title: HACK & BURST Demo
description: Connect circuits. Power up turrets. Defend your system. A roguelite action-puzzle game combining falling block-puzzles and tower defense! Align blocks to open circuits, build devastating sub-skills like chain lightning, black holes, and massive lasers, and obliterate incoming cyber threats!

title: AscendiA Demo
description: Ever dreamed of being a shonen manga hero? Ascendia is a pixel-art action roguelike where hidden Easter eggs grant special powers called Astra, and secret classes await discovery. Uncover secrets to grow stronger, and let your choices and actions shape your ending. Your awakening starts here.

title: This Flash Contains Horrors Demo
description: Psychological horror collection, which includes 5 games: GambleHeart, ROMASHKA, You Are Doxxed, B*tch!, LOOP and COLORFOOD Inc. These are stories about anxiety, pressure, and internal tension linked by a shared atmosphere.

title: Prime World Legends Demo
description: Prime World is a free online game in RPG / MOBA genre with a unique universe where tactical session battles, castle management, and hero development are mixed together. It is inspired by the original Prime World by Nival.ATTENTION: Prime World Legends is a fan-made game based on the original Prime World.

title: Hexograph Demo
description: Hexograph is a hexagonal twist on nonogram puzzles. Use logic to solve handcrafted multi-color grids, read clues across three directions, untangle special hint rules, and reveal colorful hidden pictures.

title: Brush Rush Demo
description: Paint your own parkour path to escape in this new "Brush Rush" multiplayer, casual, tag game! Runners try to escape by painting 3D paths around a parkour map to hide from the chasers who get super human movement, a paint shotgun, and a pair of boxing gloves. Public matches and streaming is welcome!

title: Chick'n Chip Demo
description: Play as Piou, a plucky little chick, in the Chick'n Chip demo: an action-shooter with a heavy dose of rogue-like. Shoot, dodge and collect golden chips to buy the powers you'll need to take down Midas, the tyrant chicken!

title: Zombie Motel 96 Demo
description: ZOMBIE MOTEL 96 is a tycoon at the end of the world. You check in, ration, quarantine, evict, scavenge and shoot to keep a roadside motel running. Every guest is one more gun on the fence, one more mouth to feed, one more noise the horde can hear. So, manager: how many people, for how many weeks?

title: Ravenian Conquerors Demo
description: A real-time sandbox strategy game across the vast archipelago of Ravenia, with a new island every play. Lead a faction, raise armies, and seize cities as you evolve through four ages. Prepare for a cosmic crisis that could end everything. Stand against it, or become the crisis itself.

title: 任意杂货铺 Demo
description: Stock up, arrange the trays, set your prices—make every hand reaching over the counter scramble to pay in Spirit Stones. Set out from the “Anywhere Door,” travel through a dozen-plus sects opening shops and doing business; Solve puzzles, rescue the elders, become a sect’s divine beast.

title: HEATSINK Demo
description: The free demo of HEATSINK, a first-person roguelite where standing still gets you killed. Two sectors of the Descent, up to THE HAMMERMAN, plus two FLIGHT courses.

title: Hazard Levels Demo
description: Enter unstable rifts, survive otherworldly creatures, and grab bizarre ingredients to fuel a secret brewery hidden beneath a British pub. Hazard Levels is a 1–4 player physics-driven co-op survival horror where the deeper you go, the stranger it gets. Just make it back before last orders.

title: Loot Tower Demo
description: Fight, loot, climb, repeat! Fight endless waves of monsters in this Rougelite Bullet Heaven with ARPG item progression.

title: 侠不义·昙花一线 Demo
description: 武侠、卡牌、肉鸽、摸金夺宝！ 武侠对抗中的一招一式，我们通过卡牌策略的方式实现了！ 经典的实克虚，虚克架，架克实，考验策略而非反应！ 如果你喜欢武侠、喜欢牌组构筑、还喜欢一点点打造强大的侠客队伍，那必须体验一下！

title: Are You an Honest Merchant? Demo
description: Join the table in this multiplayer card game up to 8 players. Merchants haul goods into town hoping to earn a glorious pile of gold, but one Inspector stands in the way. Bluff, bargain, and pray they do not find the illegal goods hidden in your wagon.

title: Warota: I Live Next to The Demon King's Castle LOL Demo
description: 【Village-Building Action RPG】Reincarnated into a ravaged world ruled by the Demon King. Gather resources, build your village, and swap hats to change classes! But when the Idol Demon King throws a live concert, a massive wave of hyped-up monsters stampedes straight toward your village!

title: Lynxwood: The Secrets Beneath Demo
description: Play the opening chapter of Lynxwood: The Secrets Beneath first-person survival horror. Your grandfather is missing, and his trail ends at a dark apartment building in the town of Lynxwood. Follow his last steps, manage your dying flashlight, and uncover what he found beneath the town.

title: Magic Cards Duel Demo
description: A fast-paced and chaotic party card game for 2 or 4 players. Players use unique card abilities to outsmart opponents, make fun tactical choices each round, and turn the match in their favor.

title: When Civilians Dig Holes Demo
description: An incremental game about digging a hole to the other side of the world.

title: Spirestorm Demo
description: Try Spirestorm's dive-and-rebound combat in an arcade action roguelite demo. Strike enemies, control your momentum in midair, and climb against rising fire. Discover how every hit can launch you toward the summit.

title: Zombie Police: Midsummer Unhappy New Year Demo
Involved Demo
description: Build spaceships block by block, lift off, mine, trade and explore a procedural low-poly solar system — alone or with friends. Crash, rebuild, repeat. Now with optional PvP: turrets, shields, missiles and raids.

title: I SHALL NAME THE DEAD Demo
description: This demo contains the opening chapter of I SHALL NAME THE DEAD. Speak with the Nameless Dead, uncover their forgotten names, and begin your descent into the Necropolis before the Worm devours you from within.

title: Incredigble Demo
description: Click on rocks to get money, find fossils, buy powerups, and grow in power! Fill and expand your museum with your discoveries, and become famous!

title: Amiko Legends Demo
description: Charm - Risk - Extract. Only what you extract is yours to keep! Team up with Amiko and venture into an untamed world shaped by your actions.

title: Slime Break Demo
description: Tower defense against a horde of thousands of slimes. Build walls, towers and traps along a funnel, pick level cards that bend each run, and watch the mass pile up, split and break through. Spend essence between runs to grow stronger.

title: Fox Arcana Demo
description: Delve into the mystical depths of the Forest in this captivating roguelike. You play as a courageous fox, wielder of powerful spells, the last bulwark against the growing corruption.

title: Flame, Cats & Kitchen Demo
description: Draw your ingredients, cook them, and feed hungry cats! A cozy cooking game in a colorful paper kitchen. Cut out your creations, add flavor with special crayons, and use heat and stirring to make each guest's meal just right

title: WORK WORK WORK PROLOGUE
description: WORK. DIE. REPEAT. Can you break out from the sinister cycle in the PROLOGUE chapter of "WORK WORK WORK"? Find clues and gather information to find your way out of the loop. And maybe you can discover the truth about the meaning in working, and living.

title: That's Exactly What a Wolf Would Say! - Demo
description: An online social deduction game for up to 10 players. Live the cottage dream by day and survive the wolves by night! You hear howling outside, and the Witch isn't on the line... Coincidence? That's EXACTLY what a wolf would say!

title: Roly-Poly Panda: Desktop Pet Demo
description: A desktop pet panda who lives on your screen. Pat it, squish it, pick it up and toss it, or offer bamboo and watch it react. While you work, it munches, naps, climbs windows, and peeks in from the screen edge, quietly keeping you company.

title: Fake Hero Demo
description: Fight alone or alongside friends as a cast of unconventional “heroes,” each with their own unique abilities. Battle endless waves of monsters, collect items, learn skills, choose talents, and create your own powerful build as you defeat mighty foes and fight your way!

title: Nothing But Cats Demo
description: This is a game that fills your desktop with cats. Cats will constantly spawn to clutter your screen until you either have a mental breakdown or your soul is healed! You can never touch the cats—the closer you try to get, the further away they run!

title: Table of War Demo
description: Command an army, not a hero. Your units move and fight on their own action points; the deck is your command channel. Every soldier is named, promoted, and gone for good when they fall. This demo is the opening act of the campaign — one commander, one act, one run at a time.

title: Fraga Demo
description: You are a pilgrim lost in a mysterious forest. Survive in this procedurally generated, turn-based tactical roguelite inspired by Galician mythology. Upgrade your gear, adapt your strategy and remember: something is always lurking in the shadows.

title: Tenebrarium Demo
description: An idle-like alien colony simulator. Study an alien species and expand the colony to discover all their peculiar behaviours.

title: WoundWake Demo
description: WoundWake is a turn-based RPG with a parry system that explores the different facets of humanity in a world on the brink of extinction: fear, trauma, obsession, love, and corruption

title: Explosive Exchange Demo
description: A fast-paced multiplayer arena party game where up to 8 players create absurd builds, outplay their friends, and turn every match into explosive chaos. Play locally or online.

title: Paraxima Demo
description: Welcome to E.S.C. As a team of 1-3, your job is to respond to paranormal outbreaks of The Static. Investigate either as a Field Agent or an Operator. Establish the chain of events with evidence to identify the Entity. Follow the correct protocol to seal it.

title: Midnight Souvenirs Demo
description: Find unique artifacts and solve charming puzzles in this cozy yet mysterious Hidden Object Game with a Lovecraftian twist! Explore a Victorian mansion, interact with strange visitors, and unravel the house’s dark, eldritch past in this all hand-painted 2D game.

title: Kart League Manager Demo
description: Manage a Division 4 kart team and lead your drivers to the title. Raise six drivers, ban and pick maps, set your 4v4 grid and karts, then watch bumps, drafts and last-lap boosts turn the race around. Climb to Division 1, or let each driver shine in the Winter Solo Cup. Multiplayer in the full game.

title: Firewall: Defend The Grid Demo
description: FIREWALL: DEFEND THE GRID is a tower defense strategy game where you take the role of a hacker tasked with building cyberspace defense systems. Deploy hardware and software defenses and manage your compute resources to build a perfect firewall and protect your clients from the ever-growing chaos.

title: Ferryman's Obol Demo
description: A short, narrative incremental game about the weight of endless labor. You ferry the dead across the River Styx. Each with their own worries, whispers and obol. How do you come to terms with the dead? Should you?

title: Death Imminent Demo
description: Explore a planetary station lost in the far reaches of the Universe as crew members awakened from cryosleep. Work together to uncover the causes of what is happening and, if you’re lucky, survive and escape from the depths of this man-made hell.

title: Roll Value Demo
description: A kingdom faces ruin as a dragon ravages it. Guided by Mon, an AI game master, lead three adventurers and decide whom to protect. Choices and dice branch the story, and your way of choosing is revealed across five principles. A tabletop-style narrative RPG played out to live viewer comments.

title: My Staff Are Dead! Paranormal Tycoon Demo
Light Factory Demo
description: Light is your resource. Bend beams with mirrors, split them with prisms and mix them to produce new colors. Fill pixels with light and arrange them to form complex shapes. Unlock new machines and charge the beacon to expand your factory.

title: Stuck in a Trench Demo
description: Welcome to the demo of Stuck in a Trench, a WW1 autobattler

title: Balingo Demo
description: Balingo is a bingo roguelike where every ball counts. Buy cards, mark off numbers, and combine tickets, stamps, markers, and marbles to create unique combos and reach increasingly higher scores before you run out of balls.

title: Beyond Acrimony Demo
description: Beyond Acrimony is a first-person psychological horror set within the fractured spaces of a grieving mind. Explore shifting liminal environments shaped by emotion, solve cryptic puzzles, and confront what your mind refuses to let go of.

title: Swarmbreaker Demo
description: Swarmbreaker is an incremental tower defense game where you must defend your base from a giant living wave of alien bugs. Build defenses to block their path, deploy heavy weapons, upgrade your arsenal, and break the swarm!

title: Board Of The Future Demo
description: Is it a board? Is it a plane? Is it the coolest, fastest piece of alien technology from the future that you and your friends have ever been riding?

title: Spirit of Diwata Demo
description: Heal instead of fight. A cozy co-op JRPG for up to three, on one screen or online, set in an Asian fantasy world where you play elemental spirit instruments to calm the creatures you meet. Every creature is someone to bond with, and each friendship brings a little more hope to the world.

title: The House Before Demo
description: You wake up as a House. Your bones are pipes and tunnels. Your organs are a labyrinth of caves. The House Before is a narrative body horror adventure where you play as a monstrous structure filled with strange creatures.

title: Legendum Demo
description: Start as a nobody and become a legend before old age claims you in this incremental RPG. Fight hordes in idle combat, plan your days, and train your skills. Grow your soul and unravel a dark plot across generations. Every life reshapes the world, and one will finish what the rest began.

title: Tiny Dwellings Demo
description: Tiny Dwellings is a cozy pixel-art builder with over 1,000 hand drawn items to place, decorate, and unwind with. Create charming little homes and tiny dioramas at your own pace, surrounded by calm lo-fi vibes, soft lighting, and cozy ambience.

title: Life Death Exit Demo
description: A first-person adventure through a surreal environment that was built to punish people for entertainment. Outsmart traps, press buttons, evade spikes, and choose Life, Death or Exit.

title: PixelHeroScramble Plus Demo
description: Intercept the surging waves of pixels with a variety of units! Experience the ultimate fixed-route tower defense! Summon a wide variety of units to defend and conquer the battlefield. Where and when you deploy, upgrade or replace your units is up to you. Discover synergies and hone your strategy.

title: BeBalance Demo
description: Balance a broom on one finger and negotiate with gravity. Move the mouse, correct each wobble, charge a flick, and survive wind, parrots, and questionable physics. Balance may be a skill—or simply the art of not falling yet.

title: Bake It Tight Demo
description: Build and rework a compact cookie factory in the Bake It Tight demo. Combine dough colors, shapes, and toppings, transform and share limited machines, and adapt your production lines to changing orders across uniquely shaped maps.

title: Loot Nook Demo
description: Loot Nook is an idle loot RPG that hides in the corner of your desktop. Heroes fight, explore, and loot — while you work or study. Mix classes, skills, and gear. Check in, collect, and upgrade. Build your build and watch your power climb!

title: Chaikov Party: Stickman Shooter Demo
description: Take what you can, run if you must. Stuff everything into your backpack, make it to the edge of town alive, and sell it all to that dealer who buys anything. He might not pay top dollar, but it'll be enough to get you some new gear, a few painkillers, and turn you into the coolest guy on this street

title: slacking simulator demo
description: Make good use of words and personas to conceal yourself amid the chaotic workplace, gain your leaders’ trust, steer clear of blame-shifting colleagues, keep learning and mastering skills, and ultimately create your own.

title: Gunfire & Magic Demo
description: A co-op idle minimalist desktop extraction game you can play with friends! In a city destroyed by a strange force, many factions covet advanced science and magic—and you step into this land of opportunity. Fight, search, extract, grow stronger, build your base, and uncover your origins!

title: Super Retro Race Demo
description: Drift, boost and race against the clock in Super Retro Race Demo. Drive two cars through six connected chapters, from the Coast to the Highway, with traffic, track challenges and a retro atmosphere.

title: Steak Simulator: Medium Rare Demo
description: As a steak, you must rediscover and navigate this bizarre world, overcome daunting challenges, and cook yourself to perfection to become a delectable delicacy. You can also team up with your friends and dash into thrilling, high-speed steak races!

title: PALE ANIMUS Demo
description: PALE ANIMUS is a Lovecraftian-inspired, Survival Horror RPG. Thomas Cassian seeks help from the infamous Witch, Keziah Mason, to learn how to access the physical realm of mind and dreams, known as the Pale.

title: Tiny Survivors Demo
description: Carve a path through massive hordes of enemies while creating ridiculously broken builds. Collect powerful loot, unlock new characters, and combine upgrades to create a tiny but unstoppable force. How long can you survive the onslaught?

title: Square Force Demo
description: Run. Shoot. Swear. Repeat. Square Force is a chaotic 3-player co-op survival shooter where you fight through escalating phases, upgrade your arsenal, hunt portal combinations, gamble on Chaos Cubes, and survive long enough to face the boss.

title: Gym Tidy Up Demo
description: Who's going to clean up that gym chaos?You, of course! In Gym Tidy Up, put the scattered dumbbells, yoga mats, and boxing gloves back where they belong. Memorize the spots for the heavy plates and make the place spotless. Remember, not everyone can lift heavy, but everyone should keep the gym clean!

title: Duo Control Demo
description: Two players, one character. One of you moves (Keyboard), the other aims and shoots (Mouse). Let's see if you and your friend are really as good a team as you think you are.

title: Neon Breaker: Endless Arcade Demo
description: Neon Breaker is a fun twin-stick horizontal 3d retro shoot 'em up in the legacy of the great action arcade shmup classics. Shoot, evade, and hunt down cute enemy ships to make them all explode! Push your limits playing through endless waves and unlock new high scores.

title: Stick Mania Demo
description: Stick Mania is a mix of 2D/3D platforming elements with stick figures that battle each other until one winner is decided

title: Inearth Demo
description: A tactical turn-based roguelite with environmental interactions, spellcrafting, and deckbuilding. Descend into the Hollow Earth. As above, so below.

title: Chop chop! JUICE SHOP Demo
description: Chop fruit, earn money, unlock powerful upgrades, and create the Ultimate Juice in this colorful incremental action game.

title: Destroy the Flag Demo
description: Try Destroy the Flag against bots! Nobody has HP: bombs launch you, freeze you solid, and hurl you across the map instead. Blast your way to the enemy flag before they blast you first, and survive absurd random events like meteor strikes, bouncing dodgeballs, and rogue ice cubes.

title: Die and Decay Demo
description: Die and Decay DEMO

title: Chaos The Devil Demo
description: A Ps1 era inspired 3D platformer. Run, jump and fly your way through a new adventure, done the old way.

title: UFO98 Demo
description: Defy the government, leak top-secret alien telemetry, and wake up the world… inside an isolated Win98 workstation.

title: Starting a Village from Zero Demo
description: — This is your own village-building story — You are a familiar summoned by Lily, an apprentice witch. Cook meals, construct buildings, and help create a thriving village on Lily's behalf. A new kind of miniscape × roguelite × turn-based strategy game.

title: Geometry TD Demo
description: The free demo of Geometry TD: tower defense on a starship you build and fly yourself. Fly through open space, put your crew to work, and stop a pirate boarding with geometric towers. Play time is limited to 15 minutes.

title: CRADLE PLANT: First Year Operations Demo
Loadpath Demo
description: Try LOADPATH, a first-person physics demolition game. Cut the supports, trigger cascading collapses and turn Salvage into a stronger demolition rig. Explore the first 55 metres of The Midden in this demo.

title: Free Company Demo
description: A co-op tactical RPG set on the eve of the year 1000. Lead a free company of mercenaries across a doom-haunted medieval world. Take the contracts, win the fights, and decide what your company becomes before the millennium turns.

title: Tulip Simulator Demo
description: A Tulip simulator where you crossbreed tulips, uncover impossible genetics, and discover flowers that have never existed before, from delicate heirlooms to crystalline wonders and blooms kissed with gold. Capture your rarest creations and share them with the world.

title: Reroll or Die Demo
description: Reroll or Die is a roguelike deck-builder where everything is decided by dice rolls. Yes, even the start button. But fortunately you can turn the odds in your favor: reroll, upgrade, invert, split, combine, increase or decrease your rolls, then slot them into your weapon and armor cards.

title: Connected Hearts: Vanished Beauty Collector's Edition Demo
description: A seaside cult is choosing its victims. Uncover dark secrets, solve puzzles, and stop a prophet before his final ritual begins.

title: Kill King 2D Demo
description: Kill King 2D is a dark fantasy 1v1 tactical auto-battler. Secretly queue orders and spend Action Points, then watch your pieces carry out the plan on their own. Evolve your army, outpredict your rival, and kill the enemy King.
developer: Anton Katkov, Nikita Gavrilchik, Dmitriy Shchepetkov

title: Aesthoria : Beyond The Realm Demo
description: A monster-collector tactical JRPG inspired from Digimon World 2, where you summon, train, evolve, and command mysterious Aesther through grid-based battles and dangerous expeditions into the shifting realm of Vanadis.

title: Country Walk Demo
description: A relaxing walking and exploration game set in the ever-changing countryside of Avelon. Follow winding paths, meet and talk with travellers, take photographs, build your photo album and share unique walks with others using Waymarks.

title: Kennel Chaos: Daycare Simulator Demo
description: You and your friends run a dog daycare. It goes badly. Feed them, wash them, walk them, and scoop what they leave behind, before somebody props a gate open and eleven dogs discover the front door. Co-op chaos with very good pups.

title: Demon Crisis Demo
description: A classic On-Rails Shooter, compatible with every modern USB lightgun with live recoil. Hide in cover to avoid hits and reload, then emerge to shoot your way through a horde of bloodthirsty demons.

title: HABAP Demo
description: A cozy reseller sim set behind the iron curtain: comb the flea markets, haggle stubborn sellers down, and flip your finds through a little shop of your own. One catch: profiteering is a capital offense here, so every ruble of profit goes toward escaping the country - before they come for you.

title: JUST PRESS SPACE Demo
description: JUST PRESS SPACE is a brutal pixel-art roguelite where one button controls everything.

title: SteelBlade Shop Simulator Demo
description: SteelBlade Shop Simulator lets you run your own SteelBlade shop in the streets of Japan. Open SteelBlade boxes, collect parts with different tiers, build powerful SteelBlades, sell them for profit, or take them into the arena and compete to prove your skill.

title: Izzy's Arcade Demo

title: How To Ride Elevator Like A Human Demo
description: A chill puzzle game about an alien trying to understand one of humanity’s strangest social rules: why does everyone avoid eye contact in elevators?

title: Neon Gamble Trail Demo
description: Cyberpunk roguelike slot game. Enter a neon tavern. Roll three numbers 1–9 for winning combos to battle rivals. Collect numbers and tokens to strengthen your build. Explore branching paths, encounter random events, and recover at supply stops. Strategize, spin reels, and create an unbeatable lineup.

title: Streamer Survival Demo
description: A frantic survival-style game where you control the character while your chat (Twitch, YouTube, and Kick) generates enemies in real time using commands. Survive waves of enemies influenced by dynamic weather as your community does everything in its power to destroy you.

title: MeMoMi Remake Demo
description: The MeMoMi Remake demo features a complete playable section from the beginning of the game.The demo is still in development. Some visuals, text, and features may be changed in the full release.

title: Unmoored Isle Demo
description: On a remote offshore island, players enjoy a simulation game blending farming, business, city-building, and defense. Core gameplay: grow crops, run shops, construct the town, and repel pirate raids. A unique gate-interrogation system lets players screen travelers, balancing order and prosperity.

title: Jet Scalawag: The King of Shooters Demo
description: Fight the mother of all space battles in an epic space combat shooter to end all space combat shooters! In this demo, Jet Scalawag must shoot down the enemy fighters of the alien armada and survive their onslaught. Later features will involve the defence of earth's military forces and space station.

title: Incident 24 Demo
description: A hand-drawn 2D action platformer set in a sci-fi world. Explore the perilous Ancient Ruins No. 24, master fluid movement to dodge deadly traps, and utilize precise combat mechanics to fight mutated monsters for survival.

title: Frostwake: The Last Ember Demo
description: A survival city builder on the ice. Keep the Furnace burning, feed and house the last people on Earth, write the laws that decide what they become, and hold the walls when the Thaw wakes what froze on the slope.

title: 循环公寓：访客 Demo
description: You’ve come to visit a friend you haven’t seen in years. 305 is unlocked, but no one is home. When you try to leave, the apartment building changes. Find a way out.

title: Ablahshikar Demo
description: Ablahshikar is a turn-based ASCII salvage-survival game adrift on the Candle Sea. Bound to a worn terminal of bone-white and brass, you must strip wrecks and tear organs direct from rival vessels. Graft severed parts onto your keel to rebuild a failing warship into a doomed chimera.

title: Clowntown Demo
description: A co-op minigame campaign for 2-8 clowns. Collaborate or sabotage your way through evolving minigames and hand-crafted action puzzles and that will have you laughing, screaming, and honking with your friends.

title: Welcome to Hell Resort! DEMO
description: Try Welcome to Hell Resort!, a tower defense game built around tile placement. Extend corridors, combine turrets, traps, and guard stations, and choose blueprints to build your defenses in hell.

title: Pretty Home Run Derby - Re: Return of KUSOGAKI Demo
description: A high-tempo batting game with an overwhelmingly satisfying hit feel. Master the "Mystery Skills" that trigger all kinds of phenomena and take on powerful foes! Can you defeat the pitchers across all 20 stages?

title: Disbond Demo
description: A PvP multiplayer zombie shooter. 2 game modes. 8 classes. One of you's already infected. You just don't know which one yet. Barricade, escape, retaliate.. Do what you must to survive and lead the scoreboard, but who can you truly trust? Because one bite turns you and the wrong turn bites you.

title: Drapers: Merchants of Middle Ages Demo
description: Build a medieval trade empire in under 30 minutes! Produce luxury cloth, manage your economy resources, and outsmart up to 7 rivals in this turn-based, Euro-style tabletop board game. Play solo or over LAN. Will you dominate the Mediterranean market or lose it all to pirates?

title: Archives of Disorder - Pasture Without Light Demo
Fall Off Reach Demo
description: Fall Off Reach is a first-person narrative survival game and the sequel to Drift Into Eternity. Alone in the wreck of the WANDERER IV, explore, repair failing systems, and delay the inevitable as everything keeping you alive collapses.

title: Fluendora: The realm of scribes Demo
Stealthmate: A chess puzzle Demo
description: Play the Stealthmate demo: solve stealth puzzles with chess movement, team up in local co-op, or challenge a bot or another player in local and online Versus. Read patrols, plan your moves, and lead your pieces to safety.

title: MR MAGEBOY Demo
description: A cozy incremental game about an aspiring mage trying to start a business selling resources. Upgrade your spells, explore biomes, and help your village!

title: Lootkeeper: Tidy up the loot Demo
The Lubs 2: Straw Hats Demo
description: The Lubs 2 : Straw Hats is a 2D action platformer game with RPG factors. Answer the Holy Council's call and fight against Krilton rebellion! The Straw Hats must be paid of their debt and Yunlingen must be in peace again!

title: Artist's Toolkit! Demo
description: Your everyday art asset toolbox. Remove backgrounds, extract frames, split transparent images into layers, and arrange assets in freeform or grid layouts. With video and pixel tools plus PNG, ZIP and PSD export, Artist's Toolkits helps you spend less time preparing assets and more time creating.

title: Jaded Jade Jayden Demo
description: Help Jayden get rid of those pesky workers that entered princess Yunlong palace uninvited!

title: Motive Power Demo
description: Take charge of BR's diesel fleet from 1968 to 1971. Twelve classes, from the 08 shunters to the Deltics, and every locomotive an individual. Four years of the real railway: the Westerns and Deltics in their prime, the Hymeks and Warships running down.

title: Be a Pirate! Demo
description: Defend your pirate fleet from the Crownsmen - and the monsters that lurk beneath. Command Cannons, Voodoo Cauldrons and more across the land and sea, rescue and upgrade a crew of missing pirate captains to assist you while you face down the Crown and their dark plan. Think, don't just click!

title: Fill the Sky Demo
description: A factory automation game where you are the mind of a self-replicating interstellar probe. Turn barren rock and ocean into sprawling industry that feeds the data centers you run on. Launch copies of yourself until they fill the sky. No enemies. Build at your own pace.

title: DeckDEX - TCG Live Simulator DEMO
description: Buy low, read the room, flip it. DeckDEX is a card-flipping market tycoon: hunt underpriced cards on a live player economy, rip packs, forge duplicates into rarities, complete sets, and build a cardboard empire.

title: Horror Stories: Social Problems Demo
description: An unsettling blend of life simulation and psychological horror with PSX style visuals. Rebuild your life, find a job, explore the town, and uncover what hides beneath an ordinary routIne.

title: Pouring Pints Demo: First Rounds On Us
Mind the Clown: Reborn Demo
description: A first-person survival horror game set in a cursed circus shaped by childhood memories. Move carefully and hide from the demonic clown stalking you. Explore dangerous attractions and burn circus posters to break the curse and save your life.

title: Jellystar Empires: When Space Bunnies Attack!! Demo
Dead Set Warriors Demo
description: Unleash the fighters of time once more for a showdown unlike no-other! Fight your way through different time periods, use your environment to your advantage and become the ultimate warrior!

title: 101 Circuits Demo
description: Build circuits and match target waveforms in the 101 Circuits demo. Connect components, inspect signals on the oscilloscope, and learn how each part works. Use Sandbox to experiment with your own circuits. No programming required.

title: Back on Your Feet Demo
description: A boxing action-adventure built on redemption. Fight up a tournament bracket where every opponent has a story of his own, make choices you can't take back, and circle, weave, and throw every punch yourself. Do you have what it takes to get back on your feet?

title: SUPER GAHAKU Demo
description: Draw in 3D space! Create hilariously wonky sculptures from topics, then laugh and guess what everyone was trying to make. The worse you are at drawing, the more fun it gets! In the demo version, “Create and Guess” is playable (multiplayer only).

title: Ballzy: PvP Block Puzzle Demo
description: Build routes, solve the first 10 Puzzle levels, and read your rival in hidden-block battles. Play 5 Classic games and 3 Battle matches.

title: Pinch n Roll Demo
description: About the DemoFlick it. Buff it. Brawl it.Jump into the ridiculous world of Pinch N Roll, an online and local physics-based brawler where you flick, smash and launch your bean through chaotic arenas.Battle your friends, collect powerful buffs and fight for your chance to reach the egg.

title: Beavertale Demo
description: Beavertale demo version

title: Undershroom Demo
description: Take a bite of surreal psychological horror. Explore a world where familiar places twist, reality slips, and your own eyes can't be trusted. Uncover what happened and dare to discover what lies beneath the shroom.

title: Guns of Eschaton Demo
description: A one-of-a-kind soulslike FPS set in an apocalyptic Western. Study who hunts you, count every bullet, fight through death again and again in a standalone adventure crafted just for the demo and offering a concentrated taste of the full game.

title: Temple oF Glyphs Demo
description: Temple of Glyphs is a logic puzzle game. Puzzles governed by enigmatic glyphs await. Decipher the rules and explore the temple.

title: Goddle Demo
description: A demo for the Goddle game!Includes the standard mode, a fixed-size grid and a fixed timer.Have fun!

title: Rekindled: Cozy Tavern Life Demo
description: Rekindled is a co-op tavern game with a twist - there's no stress! Forage, Fish, Farm and Cook at your own pace, then decorate your dishes and tavern before welcoming your customers in.

title: Cheese, Please! Demo
description: Steal cheese from the Cat Empire in an incremental bullet hell. Dodge deadly bullet patterns, collect resources, and invest your haul in permanent upgrades. Unlock dozens of weapons and perks, experiment with powerful builds, and take on increasingly dangerous bosses.

title: Dwarf Wars Demo
description: Build armies of witless dwarves and watch them fight their way to victory or fall to their doom in this physics driven, 2D battle simulator!

title: Legion's Hand Demo
description: Legion's Hand is a mahjong-inspired roguelike deckbuilder. Match three identical cards to form a Giant Soldier, or a sequence to form a Regiment. Your hand shapes your army and its formation. Collect 190+ rule-changing relics and send your winning hand into battle.

title: Cinematic Business Demo
description: Run a film studio from screenplay to theatrical release. Hire talent, control budgets, plan marketing and negotiate distribution. The free Cinematic Business demo lets you start up to three film productions over two in-game years.

title: A Bun Above Demo
description: The demo for a physics-stacking burger roguelike deckbuilder. Layers score off their neighbors and every layer adds up — but one greedy layer can bring the whole tower down. The demo gives you three chefs and a four-customer shift.

title: Silicone Heart Demo
description: Build a self-sustaining cyber farm on a planet-sized junkyard. Grow biomechanical crops, automate production, repair discarded robots, and secretly reshape a mechanical society from the inside in this cozy farming and automation adventure.

title: ChillTank Demo
description: Collect, care for, breed and trade colorful fish in a cozy aquarium game. Build your own 2.5D habitats from scratch: shape the landscape, add water and decorate a home for your fish. Play offline, at your own pace.

title: Crowd Favorites Demo
description: Step into the arena for fame and glory in Crowd Favorites, a 1v1 PvP rogue-lite fighter. Lose a round? Select crazy upgrades and stack them for chaotic synergies to get back at and outsmart your opponent in fast-paced, unpredictable duels!

title: ShirocaTriangle Demo
description: Harness the rock-paper-scissors relationship between Red, Blue, and Green attributes as you defeat enemies in this laid-back, roguelite-inspired 2D side-scrolling action game. Young witch Shiroca ventures into a mysterious forest in search of her missing roommate...

title: Black Brew Simulator Demo
description: An open world where alcohol is illegal. Produce and sell it, find customers, take over territories, grow your gang, and build a criminal empire — alone or with friends.

title: Incident Reports: Millers Residence Demo
